words.en: If you say that someone is eccentric, you mean that they behave in a strange way, and have habits or opinions that are different from those of most people.

words.ex: The embryo grows inside the mother's womb.
words.ex_cn: 胚胎在母亲的子宫内生长。
words.en: An embryo is an unborn animal or human being in the very early stages of development.

words.ex: The entrance to the building is on the left.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的入口在左边。
words.en: An entrance is a way into a place, such as a door or gate. It can also refer to the act of entering a place or the right to enter.

words.ex: The song evokes happy memories of childhood.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌唤起了对童年的美好回忆。
words.en: To evoke a particular memory, idea, emotion, or response means to cause it to occur.

words.ex: They will extend the deadline by one week.
words.ex_cn: 他们将截止日期延长一周。
words.en: To extend something means to make it longer or larger, or to spread it over a larger area.

words.ex: After running for an hour, he felt fatigue.
words.ex_cn: 跑了一个小时后，他感到疲乏。
words.en: A feeling of extreme physical or mental tiredness.

words.ex: The cake has a sweet flavor.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕有一种甜味。
words.en: The flavor of a food or drink is its taste, especially a pleasant or distinctive one.

words.ex: The storm was formidable and destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴很可怕，摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as formidable, you mean that you feel slightly frightened by them because they are very great or impressive.

words.tr:
n. 漏斗；
v. 输送；
words.ex: He poured the oil through a funnel.
words.ex_cn: 他把油通过漏斗倒了进去。
words.en: A funnel is an object with a wide, circular top and a narrow tube at the bottom, used for pouring liquids or powders into containers with small openings.

words.ex: The map shows geographic features like mountains and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图显示了山脉和河流等地理特征。
words.en: Relating to the physical features of the earth and its atmosphere, and of human activity as it affects and is affected by these, including the distribution of populations and resources, land use, and industries.

words.tr:
v. 领会；抓紧；
n. 领会；
words.ex: I couldn't grasp the meaning of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 我没能领会这首诗的含义。
words.en: To grasp something means to take it in your hand and hold it firmly.

words.ex: He faced many hardships during the war.
words.ex_cn: 他在战争期间经历了许多困苦。
words.en: Hardship refers to a situation that is difficult to endure because of lack of money, resources, or other basic necessities.

words.ex: The bee built a hexagon with wax.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂用蜡建造了一个六边形。
words.en: A hexagon is a six-sided polygon.

words.ex: He tells humorous stories that make everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他讲一些幽默的故事，让大家都笑。
words.en: If you are humorous, you are able to be amusing and to make people laugh.

words.ex: The accident immobilized his leg.
words.ex_cn: 事故使他的腿无法动弹。
words.en: To prevent something or someone from moving or operating as normal.

words.ex: He went to school in spite of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: You use in spite of to introduce a fact which makes the rest of the statement you are making seem surprising.

words.ex: The new plan incorporates feedback from students.
words.ex_cn: 新计划包含了学生的反馈。
words.en: If one thing incorporates another thing, it includes the other thing.

words.tr:
adj. 内陆的；
adv. 向内地；在内陆；
n. 内地；内陆；
words.ex: The small village is located inland, far from the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这个小村庄位于内陆，远离大海。
words.en: Inland means situated in the interior of a country rather than on the coast.

words.ex: He felt intense pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到剧烈的疼痛。
words.en: If you describe an activity as intense, you mean that it is very serious and concentrated, and often involves doing a great deal in a short time.

words.tr: v. 邀请；“invite”的现在分词； adj. 诱人的；吸引人的；
words.ex: He is inviting his friends to dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他正在邀请他的朋友来吃晚饭。
words.en: If you describe something as inviting, you mean that it has good qualities that attract you or make you want to experience it.

words.tr: n. 管辖权；司法权；裁判权；
words.ex: The court has jurisdiction over this case.
words.ex_cn: 法院对这个案件有管辖权。
words.en: The official power to make legal decisions and judgments.

words.ex: The volcano spilled hot lava down the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 火山喷出炽热的岩浆流下山。
words.en: Lava is the molten rock that comes out of a volcano during an eruption.

words.ex: The building is made of limestone.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑是由石灰岩建造的。
words.en: Limestone is a sedimentary rock composed largely of the mineral calcite (calcium carbonate: CaCO3).

words.tr:
n. 织布机；
v. 迫近；
words.ex: The old loom made a loud clicking sound.
words.ex_cn: 那台旧织布机发出很大的咔嗒声。
words.en: If something looms over you, it appears as a large or unclear shape, often in a way that is frightening or causes worry.

words.ex: The makeup of the team includes students from five countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队的组成包括来自五个国家的学生。
words.en: Makeup refers to substances applied to the face to improve or alter the appearance, or the way in which something is composed or arranged.

words.ex: He had a meager meal after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后吃了一顿很少的饭。
words.en: If you describe an amount or quantity of something as meager, you are critical of it because it is very small or not enough.

words.ex: He lives in a big metropolis with many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个有很多高楼的大都市里。
words.en: A metropolis is a very large city, often the most important city in a country or area.

words.ex: This house has a modern design.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子具有现代的设计。
words.en: Modern means relating to the present time, for example the present decade or present century.

words.ex: His motivation is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的动机是帮助他人。
words.en: Motivation is the enthusiasm or reason for doing something.

words.tr: n. 缝纫；刺绣；针线活；缝制品；绣制品
words.ex: She does needlework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 她每天晚上做针线活。
words.en: Needlework is the activity of sewing or the things that are sewn.

words.ex: He has a clear notion of right and wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他对对错有清晰的概念。
words.en: A notion is an idea or belief about something.

words.tr: adj. 冒犯的；令人不快的；进攻性的；
words.ex: His offensive words made her cry.
words.ex_cn: 他冒犯的话让她哭了。
words.en: If you describe someone's language or behavior as offensive, you mean that it is rude or insulting.

words.tr: n. 入学介绍；岗前训练；方向；取向；
words.ex: The school held an orientation for new students on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 学校在周一为新生举行了入学介绍。
words.en: The act of orienting or the state of being oriented; the determination of the relative position of something or someone (especially oneself).

words.ex: He changed his pace to match the group.
words.ex_cn: 他调整了步伐以跟上队伍。
words.en: The speed at which someone or something moves, or with which something happens or changes.

words.ex: He got a patent for his new invention.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的新发明获得了专利。
words.en: A patent is an official right to be the only person or company allowed to make or sell a new product for a certain period of time.

words.ex: His performance in the game was excellent.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的表现非常出色。
words.en: The act of performing a play, concert, or some other form of entertainment.

words.tr: n. 钢琴家；钢琴弹奏者；
words.ex: The pianist played a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这位钢琴家在音乐会上演奏了一首美妙的曲子。
words.en: A pianist is a person who plays the piano, especially professionally.

words.tr:
n. 犁；犁形器具
v. 犁；耕；艰苦前进
words.ex: The farmer uses a plow to turn the soil.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用犁翻土。
words.en: A plow is a farm tool with one or more heavy blades that breaks the soil and cuts a furrow for sowing seeds.

words.ex: He has a positive attitude toward life.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活持积极的态度。
words.en: If you are positive about things, you are hopeful and confident, and think of the good aspects of a situation rather than the bad ones.

words.ex: The old woman predict rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 那位老妇人预言明天会下雨。
words.en: If you predict an event, you say that it will happen.

words.ex: Prior to the meeting, we reviewed the report.
words.ex_cn: 在会议之前，我们复习了报告。
words.en: Existing or coming before in time, order, or importance.

words.ex: The wind propels the sailboat forward.
words.ex_cn: 风推动帆船前进。
words.en: To propel something in a particular direction means to cause it to move in that direction.

words.ex: He wants to publicize his new book.
words.ex_cn: 他想宣传他的新书。
words.en: To publicize something means to make it widely known to the public, especially by using the media.

words.ex: The radar shows a plane coming near.
words.ex_cn: 雷达显示一架飞机正在靠近。
words.en: A system for detecting the presence, direction, distance, and speed of aircraft, ships, and other objects, by sending out pulses of radio waves which are reflected off the object back to the source.

words.tr: adj. 未加工处理过的；生的；
words.ex: He eats raw vegetables every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃未加工的蔬菜。
words.en: Raw refers to something that is in its natural state and not processed or cooked.

words.tr: n. 娱乐；消遣；休闲活动
words.ex: Reading books is his favorite recreation.
words.ex_cn: 读书是他最喜欢的消遣。
words.en: Recreation is activity that you do for enjoyment or amusement when you are not working.

words.ex: The thermostat helps regulate the room temperature.
words.ex_cn: 恒温器有助于调节室温。
words.en: To regulate something means to control or manage it, especially by means of rules or laws.

words.ex: He will renew his passport next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会更新他的护照。
words.en: To renew something means to begin it again or to make it new again.

words.ex: The reservoir provides water for the nearby town.
words.ex_cn: 这个水库为附近的城镇提供水源。
words.en: A reservoir is a large quantity of a substance that is stored and can be used when needed.

words.ex: They revere their grandfather for his wisdom.
words.ex_cn: 他们因祖父的智慧而尊敬他。
words.en: If you revere someone or something, you respect and admire them greatly.

words.tr:
v. 吼叫；咆哮
n. 吼叫；咆哮
words.ex: The lion let out a loud roar.
words.ex_cn: 狮子发出了一声响亮的咆哮。
words.en: If something roars, it makes a very loud noise, like the sound of a lion.

words.tr:
n. 军刀；马刀
v. 用军刀斩
words.ex: He carries a saber to protect himself.
words.ex_cn: 他带着一把弯刀来保护自己。
words.en: A saber is a type of sword with a curved blade, used especially by soldiers in the past.

words.ex: The police discovered a scheme to steal money.
words.ex_cn: 警方发现了一个偷钱的阴谋。
words.en: A scheme is a plan or arrangement, especially one produced by a government or other organization, or a secret plan to do something, especially something illegal or dishonest.

words.tr: adv. 似乎；看似；表面上看；
words.ex: He is seemingly calm, but he is nervous inside.
words.ex_cn: 他似乎很平静，但内心很紧张。
words.en: appearing to be true or real but not necessarily so

words.tr:
n. 摇动；颤动；
v. 摇动；颤动；
words.ex: The shake of the car made me feel sick.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的摇动让我感到恶心。
words.en: To move or cause to move with quick, short movements from side to side or up and down.

words.tr:
n. 筛子；滤器
v. 筛；滤
words.ex: He used a sieve to separate sand from pebbles.
words.ex_cn: 他用筛子把沙子和石子分开。
words.en: A sieve is a tool consisting of a wire or plastic mesh held in a frame, used for separating solids from liquids or larger particles from smaller ones.

words.ex: The sloth moves very slowly in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 树懒在树上移动得非常慢。
words.en: Sloth is a disinclination to work or exert oneself; laziness, or a slow-moving tropical American mammal that lives in trees.

words.ex: He is eating soup for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他正在吃汤当午餐。
words.en: Soup is a liquid food made by boiling meat, fish, or vegetables in water or stock.

words.ex: He showed great spirit when he tried again after failing.
words.ex_cn: 他在失败后再次尝试时展现了极大的精神。
words.en: The part of a person that includes their mind, feelings, and character rather than their body.

words.ex: The stagecoach carried passengers across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 驿站马车运送乘客穿越沙漠。
words.en: A stagecoach is a large carriage pulled by horses that was used in the past to carry passengers and mail along a regular route.

words.tr: adj. 不能生育的；贫瘠的；
words.ex: The doctor said the man is sterile.
words.ex_cn: 医生说这个人不能生育。
words.en: Something that is sterile is completely clean and free from bacteria or other microorganisms.

words.ex: His strength helped him lift the heavy box.
words.ex_cn: 他的力量让他举起了那个重箱子。
words.en: The quality or state of being physically strong.

words.tr: v. 维持生活；生存下去
words.ex: They subsist on rice and vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他们靠米饭和蔬菜维持生活。
words.en: If people subsist, they are just able to obtain the food or money that they need in order to stay alive.

words.tr:
v. 使过热
n. 过热
words.ex: The oven will superheat the metal until it glows.
words.ex_cn: 烤箱会将金属过热，直到它发红。
words.en: To heat (a substance) above its boiling point without converting it into vapor.

words.tr:
n. 群；蜂群
v. 云集；充满
words.ex: Bees swarm around the flower.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂围绕着花朵成群飞舞。
words.en: A swarm is a large group of insects, especially bees, moving together. As a verb, it means to move in or form a swarm.

words.ex: The movie was tame and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影枯燥无味。
words.en: If you describe an animal as tame, you mean that it is not afraid of humans and is not dangerous. If you describe a person or their behavior as tame, you mean that they are not very exciting or interesting.

words.ex: The store is temporarily closed.
words.ex_cn: 这家店暂时关闭了。
words.en: For a limited time; not permanently.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.ex: The can is made of tin.
words.ex_cn: 这个罐子是锡做的。
words.en: Tin is a soft, silvery-white metal that is often used to coat other metals to prevent them from rusting. It is also used in the production of tin cans and other containers.

words.tr:
n. 塔；塔楼；
v. 高耸；
words.ex: The tower stands tall in the center of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这座塔矗立在城市中心。
words.en: A tower is a tall, narrow building, either part of a larger building such as a church or castle, or standing alone.

words.tr:
v. 治疗；对待；
n. 款待；
words.ex: The doctor will treat his fever with medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生会用药物治疗他的发烧。
words.en: If you treat someone or something in a particular way, you behave towards them or deal with them in that way.

words.tr: n. 树干；大衣箱；象鼻子；
words.ex: The elephant held the branch with its trunk.
words.ex_cn: 大象用它的鼻子抓住树枝。
words.en: The main stem of a tree, below the branches, and above the ground; the main part of the body, excluding the head, arms, and legs; the long, flexible nose of an elephant; a large, strong box used for transporting or storing clothes and other personal possessions.

words.ex: The teacher underscored the importance of homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调了作业的重要性。
words.en: To emphasize the importance of something or to draw a line underneath a word or phrase.

words.tr: v. 接种疫苗；预防接种
words.ex: The doctor will vaccinate the child tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 医生明天会给这个孩子接种疫苗。
words.en: To vaccinate someone is to give them a vaccine, usually by injection, to prevent them from getting a disease.

words.ex: Fish and birds are vertebrates.
words.ex_cn: 鱼和鸟是脊椎动物。
words.en: A vertebrate is an animal that has a spine or backbone.

words.ex: He chose teaching as his vocation.
words.ex_cn: 他选择了教学作为自己的职业。
words.en: A vocation is a type of work that you feel you are especially suited to do and to which you give much of your time and energy.

words.ex: She weaves a basket from reeds.
words.ex_cn: 她用芦苇编织一个篮子。
words.en: If you weave cloth or a carpet, you make it by crossing threads over and under each other using a machine or a frame called a loom.

words.ex: She knits a sweater from wool.
words.ex_cn: 她用羊毛织毛衣。
words.en: Wool is the hair that grows on sheep and some other animals, which is used to make clothes, blankets, etc.

words.ex: He was absent from school yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天缺席了学校。
words.en: If someone or something is absent from a place or situation where they should be or where they usually are, they are not there.

words.ex: He acquired a new skill last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了一项新技能。
words.en: If you acquire something, you buy or obtain it for yourself, or someone gives it to you.

words.tr:
n. 总计；集合体
adj. 合计的；总的
v. （使）聚集；聚合；总计为
words.ex: The aggregate of all sales this month is $50,000.
words.ex_cn: 本月所有销售额的总计是5万美元。
words.en: An aggregate is a number of things or people that are considered as a group or a whole.

words.ex: He used an analogy to explain how the heart works.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一个类比来解释心脏是如何工作的。
words.en: If you make or draw an analogy between two things, you show that they are similar in some way.

words.ex: He loves archaeology and digs old artifacts.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱考古学，挖掘古代文物。
words.en: Archaeology is the study of the societies and peoples of the past by examining the remains of their buildings, tools, and other objects.

words.ex: The asteroid flew past Earth safely.
words.ex_cn: 这颗小行星安全地从地球旁飞过。
words.en: An asteroid is a small rocky body orbiting the sun. Large numbers of these, ranging enormously in size, are found between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter, though some have more eccentric orbits.

words.ex: The baboon is climbing a tree.
words.ex_cn: 狒狒正在爬树。
words.en: A baboon is a type of large monkey found in Africa and Arabia, which has a dog-like face and large teeth.

words.tr:
n. 战斗；
v. 战斗；
words.ex: The soldiers fought in a long battle.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们进行了一场漫长的战斗。
words.en: A battle is a violent fight between groups of people, especially one between military forces during a war.

words.tr: adj. 离奇的；奇特的；奇怪的；
words.ex: The clown wore a bizarre hat with three eyes.
words.ex_cn: 小丑戴着一顶有三只眼睛的离奇帽子。
words.en: Something that is bizarre is very odd and strange.

words.ex: He bought a brass lamp at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一个黄铜制品台灯。
words.en: Brass is a yellow-coloured metal made from copper and zinc. It is used especially for making ornaments and musical instruments.

words.tr: v. 迅速生长；急速增长
words.ex: The flowers burgeon in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，花朵绽放。
words.en: To grow or develop quickly; to flourish.

words.ex: The river flows through a deep canyon.
words.ex_cn: 河流流经一个深峡谷。
words.en: A canyon is a large valley with very steep sides and usually a river flowing along the bottom.

words.ex: He was cautious when crossing the busy street.
words.ex_cn: 他过繁忙的街道时很小心。
words.en: If you are cautious, you are careful and avoid taking risks.

words.ex: He rubbed his chest after the cough.
words.ex_cn: 他咳嗽后揉了揉胸部。
words.en: The front part of a person's body between the neck and the stomach, or a large strong box used for storing things.

words.ex: The hiker stood at the edge of the cliff.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者站在悬崖边上。
words.en: A cliff is a high area of rock with a very steep side, often at the edge of the sea or a river.

words.ex: Wheat is a basic commodity in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 小麦在许多国家是一种基本商品。
words.en: A commodity is something that is bought and sold.

words.ex: The condor flies high above the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 秃鹰在群山之上翱翔。
words.en: A condor is a very large bird of prey that lives in the mountains of South America and California.

words.tr: adj. 一致的；始终如一的；
words.ex: His answers are consistent with the data.
words.ex_cn: 他的答案与数据一致。
words.en: Someone who is consistent always behaves in the same way, has the same attitudes towards people or things, or achieves the same level of success in something.

words.tr:
v. 定罪；宣判有罪
n. 罪犯；囚犯
words.ex: The court convicted him of theft.
words.ex_cn: 法院判定他犯有盗窃罪。
words.en: If someone is convicted of a crime, they are found guilty of that crime in a court of law.

words.tr:
n. 十字形图案；纵横交错的网
adv. 十字形地；交叉着
adj. 十字形的；交叉的
v. 划十字；纵横交错
words.ex: The roads crisscross the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 道路在乡村中纵横交错。
words.en: To move or lie across something in a pattern of intersecting lines, like a network.

words.ex: The dam holds back the river water.
words.ex_cn: 水坝拦住了河水。
words.en: A dam is a barrier that stops or restricts the flow of water or underground streams. Reservoirs created by dams not only suppress floods but also provide water for activities such as irrigation, human consumption, industrial use, aquaculture, and navigability.

words.tr:
adj. 深思熟虑的；故意的；
v. 深思熟虑；
words.ex: He made a deliberate choice to quit his job.
words.ex_cn: 他深思熟虑后决定辞去工作。
words.en: If you do something that is deliberate, you planned or decided to do it beforehand, and so it happens on purpose rather than by chance.

words.ex: The room was devoid of any furniture.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间里全无家具。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is devoid of a quality or thing, you are emphasizing that they have none of it.

words.tr:
n. 纠纷；争端；
v. 对（某事）有异议；
words.ex: The dispute between the two neighbors was about the fence.
words.ex_cn: 两个邻居之间的纠纷是关于篱笆的。
words.en: A dispute is a disagreement or argument about something important.

words.ex: He dominates the conversation.
words.ex_cn: 他主宰了谈话。
words.en: To dominate means to control or govern someone or something, or to be the most important or noticeable feature of something.

words.tr:
n. 回声；
v. 回响；
words.ex: The echo came back from the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 回声从山上反弹回来。
words.en: An echo is a sound which is caused by a noise being reflected off a surface such as a wall.

words.ex: A bird emerged from the trees.
words.ex_cn: 一只鸟从树中浮现出来。
words.en: If something or someone emerges, they come out of or move out of something and become visible.

words.tr: n. 企业家；创业者；承包人；
words.ex: He is an entrepreneur who started a small coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位创办了小型咖啡店的企业家。
words.en: An entrepreneur is a person who organizes and operates a business or businesses, taking on greater than normal financial risks in order to do so.

words.ex: The bird evolved from a small dinosaur.
words.ex_cn: 这种鸟由一种小型恐龙演变而来。
words.en: If something evolves or you evolve it, it gradually develops over a period of time into something different and usually more advanced.

words.ex: The extent of his knowledge surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的知识广度让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The area or length to which something extends.

words.ex: It is feasible to finish the project in one week.
words.ex_cn: 一周内完成这个项目是可行的。
words.en: If something is feasible, it can be done, made, or achieved.

words.ex: The flaw in the glass made it break easily.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃上的瑕疵让它很容易碎。
words.en: A flaw is a mistake or weakness in something that makes it less effective or valuable.

words.ex: The teacher will formulate a new rule for class.
words.ex_cn: 老师将制定一条新的课堂规则。
words.en: If you formulate something such as a plan or proposal, you invent it, thinking about the details carefully.

words.ex: The coat is made of soft fur.
words.ex_cn: 这件外套是由柔软的毛皮制成的。
words.en: The thick hair that covers the bodies of some animals, or the hair-covered skin(s) of animals, used in making clothes and other items.

words.tr: adj. 地质学的；地质上的
words.ex: The geologic layer shows old rocks.
words.ex_cn: 地质层显示了古老的岩石。
words.en: Relating to the science that deals with the earth's physical structure and substance, its history, and the processes that act on it.

words.ex: The grasshopper jumps high in the grass.
words.ex_cn: 蚱蜢在草丛中跳得很高。
words.en: A grasshopper is a plant-eating insect with long back legs that can jump very high and makes a sharp, high noise using its back legs or wings.

words.ex: The computer needs new hardware to run faster.
words.ex_cn: 这台电脑需要新的硬件来运行得更快。
words.en: In computing, hardware refers to the physical parts of a computer and related devices. In general, hardware can be any equipment, especially tools, used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: Bears hibernate in winter to save energy.
words.ex_cn: 熊在冬天冬眠以保存能量。
words.en: To spend the winter in a dormant state.

words.ex: He felt hunger after running for an hour.
words.ex_cn: 他跑了一个小时后感到饥饿。
words.en: A strong desire or need for food.

words.ex: Legends say that some heroes are immortal.
words.ex_cn: 传说有些英雄是不死的。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as immortal, you mean that they are so famous or popular that they will be remembered for a very long time.

words.ex: The movie was incredible.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影太棒了。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as incredible, you like them very much or are impressed by them, because they are extremely or unusually good.

words.ex: The inner room is quiet and dark.
words.ex_cn: 内部的房间安静而昏暗。
words.en: Located inside or further in; relating to the mind or spirit.

words.tr:
n. 意图；目的；
adj. 专注的；
words.ex: His intent was to help, not to hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他的意图是帮助，而不是伤害。
words.en: If you are intent on doing something, you are determined to get it done. If you have an intent to do something, you have a plan or purpose in mind.

words.ex: The project involves simple math and writing.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目包括简单的数学和写作。
words.en: If a situation or activity involves something, that thing is a necessary part or consequence of it.

words.ex: The jury decided the man was innocent.
words.ex_cn: 陪审团裁定这个人无罪。
words.en: A jury is a group of people who are chosen to decide whether someone is guilty or not guilty of a crime in a court of law.

words.tr:
adj. 奢侈的；慷慨给予的；挥霍的；过多的
v. 浪费；挥霍；慷慨给予
words.ex: He threw a lavish party for his birthday.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的生日举办了一场奢华的派对。
words.en: If you describe something as lavish, you mean that it is very elaborate and impressive and a lot of money has been spent on it. If you say that someone is lavish in the way they behave, you mean that they give, spend, or use a lot of something.

words.ex: The limitation of the phone is its short battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的限制是电池续航时间短。
words.en: A limitation is a rule or situation that restricts what you can do or what can happen.

words.ex: She wore the shirt loosely over her jeans.
words.ex_cn: 她宽松地把衬衫穿在牛仔裤外面。
words.en: In a way that is not firmly or tightly fixed in place; not strictly or precisely.

words.ex: Dogs are mammalian animals.
words.ex_cn: 狗是哺乳动物。
words.en: Relating to or denoting mammals.

words.tr:
v. 缓慢而弯曲地流动；漫步；闲聊
n. 河流的曲折；漫步；迂回曲折的进程
words.ex: The river meanders through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这条河蜿蜒穿过森林。
words.en: To meander means to follow a winding and turning course, often used to describe the way a river flows or the way a person walks without a clear direction.

words.ex: The microbe causes sickness.
words.ex_cn: 这种微生物会引起疾病。
words.en: A microbe is a very small living thing, which you can only see if you use a microscope. Some microbes can cause diseases.

words.ex: He ate a moderate amount of food.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了适量的食物。
words.en: If you moderate something or if it moderates, it becomes less extreme or violent, or if you moderate a discussion, you help the people in it to reach an agreement.

words.ex: The dog ran through the mud.
words.ex_cn: 狗跑过了泥地。
words.en: Mud is a sticky mixture of earth and water.

words.ex: The needy family received food from the charity.
words.ex_cn: 这个贫穷的家庭从慈善机构收到了食物。
words.en: Needy people do not have enough food, medicine, or clothing, or adequate houses.

words.ex: Notwithstanding the rain, they went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 虽然下着雨，他们还是去散步了。
words.en: In spite of; although.

words.tr:
n. 官员；高级职员；
adj. 官方的；正式的；
words.ex: The official announced new rules for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 这位官员宣布了节日的新规定。
words.en: An official is a person who holds a position of authority in a government or organization, or something that is authorized or formally recognized.

words.ex: The origin of this tradition is unknown.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统的起源不明。
words.en: The origin of something is the point or place where it begins, or the cause from which it arises.

words.tr:
v. 包装；收拾行李；
n. 包裹；小包；
words.ex: She packs the gift in colorful paper.
words.ex_cn: 她用彩纸包装礼物。
words.en: A pack is a container of a particular kind, especially one made of strong paper or plastic and containing a number of the same items. As a verb, pack means to put something into a container, especially in a neat and efficient way.

words.ex: He showed patience while waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在等公交车时表现出了耐心。
words.en: The ability to stay calm and not get angry, especially when there is a difficulty or you have to wait a long time.

words.ex: The moon has a periodic cycle of phases.
words.ex_cn: 月亮的相位变化是周期性的。
words.en: Happening or appearing at regular intervals.

words.ex: The pigeon sits on the window sill.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子坐在窗台上。
words.en: A pigeon is a bird, usually grey in color, that is often seen in towns and is sometimes used for carrying messages.

words.tr:
v. 摘；拔；猛拉；拨弹
n. 胆识；胆量；快而猛地拉
words.ex: He plucked a flower from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他从花园里摘了一朵花。
words.en: To pluck means to pull something quickly to remove it or to play a musical instrument by pulling the strings with your fingers. As a noun, it refers to the quality of being brave and determined.

words.ex: He possesses a small house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有一栋靠近湖边的小房子。
words.en: If you possess something, you have it or own it.

words.ex: The predominant color in the room is blue.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的主导颜色是蓝色。
words.en: If something is predominant, it is more important, noticeable, or powerful than the other things in a situation.

words.ex: He was sent to prison for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷窃被送进了监狱。
words.en: A prison is a building where criminals are kept as punishment or where people accused of a crime are kept before their trial.

words.ex: He has a propensity for telling the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他有说实话的倾向。
words.en: A propensity is a natural tendency to behave in a particular way.

words.ex: The dog stepped in a puddle.
words.ex_cn: 狗踩进了一个水坑。
words.en: A puddle is a small pool of liquid, especially of rainwater on the ground.

words.tr: v. 散发；发射（光或热）；辐射
words.ex: The sun radiates heat and light.
words.ex_cn: 太阳散发出热量和光。
words.en: To send out rays or waves, especially of light or heat; to spread out from a central point.

words.ex: He reacts quickly when he hears a loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到大声响时，他会迅速做出反应。
words.en: When you react to something that has happened to you, you behave in a particular way because of it.

words.ex: The company plans to recruit new staff next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划下个月招聘新员工。
words.en: To recruit means to enlist someone in the armed forces or to persuade someone to join a company, organization, or group.

words.tr: v. 恢复；修复；改造（罪犯）
words.ex: The hospital will rehabilitate the injured athlete.
words.ex_cn: 医院将帮助受伤的运动员康复。
words.en: To rehabilitate someone who has been ill or in prison means to help them to live a normal life again. To rehabilitate a building or an area means to improve its condition.

words.tr: v. 声明放弃；与...断绝关系
words.ex: He renounced his citizenship last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年放弃了国籍。
words.en: If you renounce a belief or a way of behaving, you say and show that you no longer hold that belief or will behave in that way.

words.tr: v. 重塑；改造；给…以新形态
words.ex: He wants to reshape his life after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他想在事故后重新塑造自己的生活。
words.en: To reshape something means to change its form or structure, often in order to improve it.

words.tr:
n. 反面；
v. 使倒转；（使）倒车；撤销；
words.ex: The reverse of the coin has a picture of a tree.
words.ex_cn: 硬币的反面有一棵树的图案。
words.en: If you reverse the order of a set of things, you arrange them in the opposite order, so that the first thing comes last.

words.ex: The rocky path made hiking difficult.
words.ex_cn: 多岩石的小路让徒步变得困难。
words.en: A rocky area is covered with rocks or consists of large areas of rock and has nothing growing on it.

words.tr:
n. 袋子；
v. 劫掠；
words.ex: He carried the apples in a burlap sack.
words.ex_cn: 他把苹果装在一个麻布袋里。
words.en: A sack is a large bag made of rough woven material, used for storing or carrying goods. It can also refer to the act of dismissing someone from employment or the act of looting a place.

words.ex: The scholar published a book about ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这位学者出版了一本关于古代历史的书。
words.en: A scholar is a person who studies an academic subject and knows a lot about it.

words.ex: Water seeped through the cracks in the wall.
words.ex_cn: 水从墙上的裂缝中渗出。
words.en: If something such as liquid or gas seeps somewhere, it flows slowly and in small amounts into a place where it should not go.

words.ex: The rock layer is made of shale.
words.ex_cn: 这层岩石由页岩组成。
words.en: Shale is a type of sedimentary rock formed from clay that is compacted together by pressure.

words.ex: He lost sight of the bird flying away.
words.ex_cn: 他看不见那只飞走的鸟了。
words.en: The ability to see; the act of seeing or the thing seen.

words.tr:
n. 闻；气味；嗅觉；
v. 嗅；闻；散发气味；察觉；
words.ex: The smell of fresh bread made me hungry.
words.ex_cn: 新鲜面包的香味让我饿了。
words.en: The faculty or power of perceiving odors or scents by means of the organs in the nose.

words.ex: The new house has a spacious living room.
words.ex_cn: 这所新房子有一个宽敞的客厅。
words.en: A spacious room, building, or place is large in size or area, so that you can move around freely in it.

words.tr: adj. 壮观的；辉煌的；极好的；
words.ex: The sunset over the mountains was splendid.
words.ex_cn: 山上的日落非常壮观。
words.en: If you say that something is splendid, you mean that it is very good.

words.ex: The water in the pond was stagnant.
words.ex_cn: 池塘里的水不流动。
words.en: If something such as a business or economy is stagnant, there is little activity or change.

words.tr:
v. 炖；焖；烦恼
n. 炖煮的菜肴；忧虑
words.ex: He is stewing vegetables on the stove.
words.ex_cn: 他正在炉子上炖蔬菜。
words.en: A stew is a meal made by cooking meat, fish, or vegetables slowly in liquid.

words.tr:
n. 压力；强调；
v. 着重；强调；
words.ex: He feels stress from too much work.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作太多而感到压力。
words.en: Stress is a state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.

words.ex: This bird is a subspecies of the robin.
words.ex_cn: 这种鸟是知更鸟的一个亚种。
words.en: A subspecies is a taxonomic category that ranks below species, usually a fairly permanent geographically isolated race.

words.ex: The superintendent of the school is very strict.
words.ex_cn: 学校的主管非常严格。
words.en: A superintendent is a person who is in charge of a particular department or activity, especially within a school, housing project, or police force.

words.ex: He sweats heavily after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后大量出汗。
words.en: Sweat is the salty liquid that comes out through the skin when you are hot, ill, or afraid.

words.tr:
n. 晒成棕褐色的肤色
adj. 棕褐色的；棕黄色的
v. 将皮肤晒成棕褐色
words.ex: He has a deep tan after spending the week at the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他在海滩度过一周后，皮肤晒成了深棕色。
words.en: If you tan, or if the sun tans you, your skin becomes darker because you spend time in the sun.

words.ex: The tenant pays rent every month.
words.ex_cn: 房客每个月支付租金。
words.en: A tenant is a person who rents land or property from a landlord.

words.ex: The thickness of the ice is dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 冰的厚度很危险。
words.en: The quality or state of being thick, especially the distance between opposite surfaces of an object.

words.ex: The tip of the pencil broke off.
words.ex_cn: 铅笔的尖端断了。
words.en: The end of a pointed or projecting object; a sum of money given to someone as a reward for their services; to give someone a small amount of money as a reward for their services.

words.ex: The water is toxic to fish.
words.ex_cn: 这种水对鱼是有毒的。
words.en: If a substance is toxic, it is poisonous.

words.ex: The earthquake caused tremendous damage.
words.ex_cn: 地震造成了巨大的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as tremendous, you mean that they are very great in amount, extent, or intensity.

words.ex: The truth is that he was late for work.
words.ex_cn: 事实是他上班迟到了。
words.en: The truth is the true facts about something, rather than what is imagined or invented.

words.ex: I understand the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 我理解这个数学问题。
words.en: If you understand someone or understand what they are saying, you know what they mean.

words.tr:
n. 真空；空虚；
v. 用真空吸尘器打扫；
words.ex: The vacuum in space keeps no air.
words.ex_cn: 太空中的真空没有空气。
words.en: A vacuum is a space that contains no air or other gas, or a space from which most of the air or gas has been removed. It can also refer to a device that cleans floors and surfaces by sucking up dirt and dust.

words.ex: The tree grows in a vertical line.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树垂直生长。
words.en: Something that is vertical stands or points straight up.

words.ex: The alcohol is volatile and evaporates quickly.
words.ex_cn: 酒精是易挥发的，会迅速蒸发。
words.en: A volatile situation or person is one that is likely to change suddenly and unexpectedly, especially by getting worse.

words.tr:
n. 杂草；野草；
v. 除草；铲除；
words.ex: The garden is full of weeds.
words.ex_cn: 花园里长满了杂草。
words.en: A weed is a wild plant that grows in gardens or fields of crops and is not wanted because it harms the plants that are being grown.

words.ex: The bird ate a worm.
words.ex_cn: 鸟吃了一条蚯蚓。
words.en: A worm is a small, long, thin creature with no bones or legs that lives in soil.

words.ex: The sponge absorbs water quickly.
words.ex_cn: 海绵很快吸收水。
words.en: If something absorbs a liquid, gas, or other substance, it soaks it up or takes it in.

words.ex: He owns five acres of farmland.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有五英亩的农田。
words.en: A unit of area used in the US Customary and the British Imperial systems, equal to 4,840 square yards or 4,046.86 square meters.

words.tr: adj. 攻击性的；有进取心的；侵略性的；
words.ex: The dog showed aggressive behavior toward strangers.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗对陌生人表现出攻击性行为。
words.en: An aggressive person or animal has a quality of anger and determination that makes them ready to attack others.

words.ex: He analyzes data every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天分析数据。
words.en: To examine something methodically and in detail, typically in order to explain and interpret it.

words.ex: He studies architecture at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学学习建筑学。
words.en: Architecture is the art and science of designing buildings and other physical structures.

words.tr: adj. 令人惊讶的；惊人的； v. “astonish”的现在分词；
words.ex: The magician did an astonishing trick.
words.ex_cn: 魔术师表演了一个令人惊讶的魔术。
words.en: If something is astonishing, it is very surprising.

words.ex: He is the backbone of the team.
words.ex_cn: 他是团队的中坚。
words.en: The backbone is the most important part of something, providing support and strength.

words.ex: The boat is parked in the bay.
words.ex_cn: 船停在海湾里。
words.en: A bay is a body of water partially enclosed by land, typically smaller than a gulf. It can also refer to a compartment for a ship, the color of a horse, or the sound a dog makes.

words.ex: The wind turns the blade of the fan.
words.ex_cn: 风转动了风扇的叶片。
words.en: The flat cutting part of a tool or weapon, such as a knife or sword.

words.tr:
n. 违背；
v. 攻破；
words.ex: The company committed a breach of contract.
words.ex_cn: 该公司违反了合同。
words.en: A breach of a law, rule, or agreement is an act of breaking it.

words.ex: The burial took place at sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 埋葬在日出时进行。
words.en: The act or ceremony of putting a dead body into a grave.

words.tr:
v. 能；
n. 金属罐；
words.ex: I can swim very well.
words.ex_cn: 我能够游得很好。
words.en: Can is a modal verb. It is used with the base form of a verb. It is used to indicate that someone is able to do something or that something is possible.

words.ex: The dentist found a cavity in his tooth.
words.ex_cn: 牙医在他的牙齿上发现了一个腔。
words.en: A cavity is a hole or space inside something.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；首要的；
n. 领袖；首领；
words.ex: He is the chief reason for the team's success.
words.ex_cn: 他是球队成功的主要原因。
words.en: The chief is the leader of a group or organization, or the main part of something.

words.ex: The child clings to his mother's leg.
words.ex_cn: 孩子紧贴着妈妈的腿。
words.en: If you cling to someone or something, you hold onto them tightly.

words.ex: He used common sense to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用常识解决了这个问题。
words.en: Common sense is the natural ability to make good judgments and to behave in a practical and sensible way.

words.tr:
v. 实施；传导（电、热）；
n. 行为；举止；
words.ex: The company will conduct a survey next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司将在下周进行一项调查。
words.en: To organize and carry out a particular activity.

words.tr: adj. 恒定的；不变的；持续的；
words.ex: The temperature is constant in this room.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的温度是恒定的。
words.en: Something that is constant happens all the time or is always there.

words.ex: He tried to convince her to stay.
words.ex_cn: 他试图说服她留下。
words.en: If someone or something convinces you of something, they make you believe that it is true or that it exists.

words.ex: The critic praised the new movie.
words.ex_cn: 这位评论家称赞了这部新电影。
words.en: A critic is a person who expresses opinions about the good and bad qualities of books, films, music, etc.

words.ex: The ground is damp after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后地面是潮湿的。
words.en: Something that is damp is slightly wet, often in a way that is unpleasant.

words.tr: adj. 精致的；微妙的；易碎的；脆弱的；
words.ex: She wore a delicate lace dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条精致的蕾丝连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is delicate is small and beautifully shaped. It can also be easily broken or damaged.

words.tr: v. 吞食；吞噬；狼吞虎咽地吃；如饥似渴地看
words.ex: The dog devoured the meat quickly.
words.ex_cn: 狗很快地把肉吃光了。
words.en: To eat something quickly and eagerly, especially because you are very hungry; to destroy something quickly and completely.

words.ex: The scandal brought the company into disrepute.
words.ex_cn: 这起丑闻使该公司声名狼藉。
words.en: If someone or something is in disrepute, they have a bad reputation because people think they have done something bad or wrong.

words.ex: He drew a dot on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一个小圆点。
words.en: A dot is a very small round mark, for example one that is used as the top part of the letter 'i', as a full stop, or as a decimal point.

words.tr:
n. 日食；月食；黯然失色
v. 使失色
words.ex: We watched the solar eclipse last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚观看了日食。
words.en: An eclipse occurs when one celestial body moves into the shadow of another, temporarily obscuring it or cutting off its light.

words.ex: The lamp emits a soft light.
words.ex_cn: 灯发出柔和的光。
words.en: To emit means to send out something such as light, heat, sound, gas, etc.

words.tr: n. 进入；入口；条目；参与；参赛作品；
words.ex: The entry to the building is locked after 10 PM.
words.ex_cn: 建筑物在晚上10点后进入通道会被锁上。
words.en: An entry is the act of going into a place or the right to go into it. It can also refer to a door, gate, or passage by which you enter a place. Additionally, an entry can be a piece of information recorded in a book, list, or computer, or the act of recording it.

words.ex: He exaggerates his achievements to impress others.
words.ex_cn: 他夸张自己的成就来给别人留下印象。
words.en: If you exaggerate, you indicate that something is, for example, worse or more important than it really is.

words.ex: The external wall of the house is painted blue.
words.ex_cn: 房子的外墙被刷成了蓝色。
words.en: External is used to indicate that something is on the outside of a surface or body, or that it exists, happens, or comes from outside.

words.ex: Climbing the mountain without oxygen was a great feat.
words.ex_cn: 在不吸氧的情况下爬山是一项伟大的壮举。
words.en: A feat is an act or achievement that shows great courage, skill, or strength.

words.ex: He grows flax in his garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园里种植亚麻。
words.en: Flax is a plant with blue flowers. Its stem is used for making linen and its seeds are used for making linseed oil.

words.ex: The boy found a fossil in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在岩石中发现了一块化石。
words.en: A fossil is the remains or impression of a prehistoric organism preserved in petrified form or as a mold or cast in rock.

words.ex: The blacksmith heated the metal in the furnace.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠在熔炉里加热金属。
words.en: A furnace is a device that produces heat for warmth or to melt materials.

words.ex: The geomagnetic field protects Earth from solar wind.
words.ex_cn: 地磁场保护地球免受太阳风的影响。
words.en: Relating to the magnetic properties of the Earth.

words.ex: The gravity of Earth pulls objects down.
words.ex_cn: 地球的重力把物体往下拉。
words.en: Gravity is the force that causes things to fall towards the Earth or towards any other physical body having mass.

words.tr:
n. 伤害；损害；
v. 伤害；损害；
words.ex: The storm caused great harm to the crops.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对庄稼造成了很大伤害。
words.en: To harm someone or something means to cause them physical injury or to damage them in some other way.

words.tr:
v. 隐藏；躲藏；
n. 兽皮；
words.ex: He hides the key under the mat.
words.ex_cn: 他把钥匙藏在垫子下面。
words.en: To conceal something or someone from view or discovery.

words.ex: He hurled the ball across the field.
words.ex_cn: 他猛地把球投过球场。
words.en: To throw something with great force; to shout something loudly.

words.tr: adj. 有免疫力的；免疫的；不受影响的；
words.ex: Children are immune to this disease after vaccination.
words.ex_cn: 儿童接种疫苗后对这种疾病有免疫力。
words.en: If you are immune to a particular disease, you cannot be affected by it. If you are immune to something such as criticism, it does not affect you.

words.ex: The hen incubate eggs until they hatch.
words.ex_cn: 母鸡孵化鸡蛋直到小鸡孵出。
words.en: to keep eggs warm so that they develop and hatch, or to keep cells, bacteria, etc. at a suitable temperature so that they develop

words.tr: adj. 天真无邪的；无辜的；
words.ex: The innocent child smiled at the stranger.
words.ex_cn: 那个天真无邪的孩子对陌生人笑了。
words.en: If someone is innocent, they did not commit a crime which they have been accused of.

words.tr: v. 互相作用；互相影响；交流；沟通；
words.ex: The two chemicals interact when mixed.
words.ex_cn: 这两种化学物质混合时会互相作用。
words.en: If people interact with each other, they communicate or work together.

words.tr: adj. 有关的；有牵连的；繁杂的； v. 包括；牵涉；“involve”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is involved in the school project.
words.ex_cn: 他与这个学校项目有关。
words.en: If a situation or activity is involved, it has a lot of different parts or aspects, often making it complicated or difficult to understand.

words.tr: adj. 渴望的；热心的；敏锐的；
words.ex: He is keen to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望学习英语。
words.en: If you are keen on doing something, you very much want to do it. If you are keen that something should happen, you very much want it to happen.

words.ex: The children play on the lawn after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在草坪上玩耍。
words.en: A lawn is an area of grass that is kept cut short and is usually part of someone's garden or yard, or part of a park.

words.ex: The limner painted small portraits for the king.
words.ex_cn: 这位画师为国王画了小型肖像。
words.en: A limner is someone who paints or draws, especially in a detailed or meticulous manner.

words.ex: He is loyal to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友忠诚。
words.en: Someone who is loyal remains firm in their friendship or support for a person or thing.

words.tr:
n. 猛玛（象）；庞然大物；
adj. 巨大的；庞大的；
words.ex: The mammoth lived in cold areas long ago.
words.ex_cn: 猛犸象很久以前生活在寒冷地区。
words.en: If you describe something as mammoth, you are emphasizing that it is extremely large.

words.ex: The body has a mechanism to fight viruses.
words.ex_cn: 人体有一种对抗病毒的机制。
words.en: A mechanism is a part of a machine that does a particular task, or a system that is intended to achieve something or deal with a problem.

words.ex: The bacteria are microscopic.
words.ex_cn: 这些细菌极小。
words.en: So small as to be visible only with a microscope; of or relating to a microscope.

words.tr: adj. 不多的；适度的；谦虚的；
words.ex: He made a modest profit last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年的利润不多。
words.en: If you say that someone is modest, you approve of them because they do not talk much about their abilities or achievements.

words.ex: The store offers multiple flavors of ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供多种口味的冰淇淋。
words.en: If something is multiple, it consists of or involves many things of the same kind.

words.ex: He tries to negate the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他试图否认事实。
words.en: If someone negates something, they say that it does not exist or is not true.

words.tr: adj. 有营养的； v. “nourish”的现在分词；
words.ex: This soup is nourishing and keeps you healthy.
words.ex_cn: 这汤很有营养，能让你保持健康。
words.en: If you say that food is nourishing, you mean that it is good for your health because it contains substances that help your body to be healthy.

words.ex: The company has an offshore office in Ireland.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司在爱尔兰有一个离岸办公室。
words.en: Located or based in a foreign country, especially to take advantage of lower costs or less stringent regulations.

words.ex: The tree has many colorful ornaments.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树上有许多彩色的装饰品。
words.en: An ornament is an object that is used to make something look more attractive but is usually considered to have no practical purpose.

words.ex: He picked up the paddle and rowed the boat.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起桨划船。
words.en: A paddle is a short pole with a wide flat part at one end or both ends, used to move a small boat through water.

words.ex: He is a true patriot who loves his country.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位真正热爱祖国的爱国者。
words.en: A patriot is someone who loves their country and is willing to defend it against enemies or detractors.

words.ex: The keyboard is a peripheral device.
words.ex_cn: 键盘是一个外围设备。
words.en: A peripheral activity or issue is one that is not very important compared with other activities or issues.

words.ex: The pigment in leaves changes color in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 叶子中的色素在秋天会变色。
words.en: A pigment is a substance that gives something a particular color.

words.ex: The apple plummeted from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 苹果从树上垂直落下。
words.en: If an amount, rate, or price plummets, it decreases quickly by a large amount.

words.ex: The postage for this letter is one dollar.
words.ex_cn: 这封信的邮资是一美元。
words.en: The cost of sending a letter or package by post.

words.ex: She is pregnant and will have a baby next month.
words.ex_cn: 她怀孕了，下个月就要生宝宝了。
words.en: Having a baby developing in the uterus.

words.ex: He keeps his diary private.
words.ex_cn: 他把日记保密。
words.en: If something is private, it is for the use of one person or group, rather than for the general public.

words.tr: adj. 正确的；合适的；正当的；
words.ex: This is the proper way to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是解决这个问题的正确方法。
words.en: If something is proper, it is suitable or correct for a particular purpose, situation, or person.

words.ex: The pueblo is old and has stone houses.
words.ex_cn: 这个普韦布洛很古老，有石屋。
words.en: A pueblo is a type of Indian village built by certain peoples in the south-western United States, especially one consisting of multistorey adobe houses built by the Pueblo people.

words.ex: The sun gives off radiation.
words.ex_cn: 太阳发出辐射。
words.en: Radiation is energy that comes from a source and travels through space at the speed of light. This energy has an electric field and a magnetic field associated with it, and has wave-like properties. You could also call radiation 'electromagnetic waves'.

words.ex: I am ready for the test.
words.ex_cn: 我准备好考试了。
words.en: If you are ready, you are prepared for something or are in a suitable state to do or deal with it.

words.ex: The table has a rectangular shape.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是矩形的。
words.en: Something that is rectangular has the shape of a rectangle.

words.tr:
n. 重新加热
v. 重新加热；“reheat”的现在分词
words.ex: He is reheating his lunch in the microwave.
words.ex_cn: 他正在用微波炉重新加热他的午餐。
words.en: The act of heating something again.

words.tr: v. 租借；出租；“rend”的过去式和过去分词； n. 租金；
words.ex: They rent a small apartment in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们租了一间城市里的小公寓。
words.en: Rent refers to the payment made periodically by a tenant to a landlord for the use of property or land.

words.ex: They reside in a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一所小房子里。
words.en: If someone resides somewhere, they live there or are staying there.

words.tr:
n. 回顾；复习；审查；评论；
v. 回顾；复习；审核；评论；
words.ex: We had a quick review of last week's lesson.
words.ex_cn: 我们对上周的课程做了一个简短的回顾。
words.en: If you review something, you consider it again, especially in order to make changes to it or to give your opinion about it.

words.ex: He used a long rod to reach the top shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根长杆够到顶层架子。
words.en: A rod is a long, thin, straight bar, especially one made of wood or metal.

words.tr:
n. 马鞍；鞍座
v. 给（马）装鞍
words.ex: The boy rode on a saddle on the horse.
words.ex_cn: 男孩骑在马的马鞍上。
words.en: A saddle is a seat for a rider on the back of a horse or other animal, or a similar seat on a bicycle or motorcycle. It can also refer to the act of putting a saddle on a horse or to burden someone with a responsibility.

words.tr:
n. 分数；得分；总谱；乐谱；
v. 得分；
words.ex: He got a high score on the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了高分。
words.en: If you score a particular amount or number in a game or test, you achieve that amount or number.

words.ex: This segment of the book is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的这一部分非常有趣。
words.en: A segment of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

words.ex: The pond is shallow, so you can see the bottom.
words.ex_cn: 这个池塘很浅，所以你能看到底部。
words.en: If something is shallow, it does not extend far down from the top surface.

words.ex: He signed his name with a clear signature.
words.ex_cn: 他用清晰的签名签了名字。
words.en: A signature is a person's name written in a distinctive way as a form of identification in authorizing a document or letter.

words.tr:
n. 烟；烟雾；
v. 抽烟；冒烟；
words.ex: The fire produced thick smoke.
words.ex_cn: 火灾产生了浓烟。
words.en: Smoke consists of gas and small bits of solid material that are sent into the air when something burns.

words.tr:
n. 时距；跨度；
v. 跨越；
words.ex: The span of his career was 40 years.
words.ex_cn: 他职业生涯的时距是40年。
words.en: The extent or measure of space between two points or extremities, as of a bridge or a roof; the full extent, stretch, or reach of anything.

words.ex: He walked up the staircase to his room.
words.ex_cn: 他走上楼梯去了他的房间。
words.en: A staircase is a set of stairs inside a building, often including the supporting structure, the handrails, and sometimes the landings at the top and bottom.

words.tr:
v. 粘附；（随意）放置；忍受；
n. 棍枝；条状物；球棍；
words.ex: The glue makes the paper stick to the table.
words.ex_cn: 胶水使纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: A stick is a thin branch which has fallen off a tree. If you stick something somewhere, you put it there in a rather casual way.

words.tr:
v. 伸展；延伸；持续；
n. 一段；伸展；
words.ex: He stretches his arms every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上伸展手臂。
words.en: To stretch is to extend your body or a part of your body to its full length, or to extend something else to its full length or beyond its normal limits.

words.tr: adj. 大量的；重大的；实质性的；
words.ex: He made a substantial profit from the sale.
words.ex_cn: 他从这次销售中获得了大量的利润。
words.en: Something that is substantial is large in size, amount, or importance.

words.ex: This phone is superior to the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机比旧的更好。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as superior, you mean that they are better than other people or things.

words.ex: She sweeps the floor every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上扫地。
words.en: To clean an area by brushing away dirt or litter.

words.ex: He filled the tank with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把罐子装满了水。
words.en: A tank is a large container for holding liquid or gas, or a heavily armored fighting vehicle carrying guns and moving on a continuous articulated metal track.

words.ex: There is a tendency for people to use phones before bed.
words.ex_cn: 人们在睡觉前使用手机是一种趋势。
words.en: A tendency is a likelihood of behaving in a particular way or going in a particular direction, which is often bad or undesirable.

words.ex: He is thin.
words.ex_cn: 他很瘦。
words.en: Having a small distance between opposite sides; not thick.

words.ex: Long hours of work tire him.
words.ex_cn: 长时间的工作让他感到疲倦。
words.en: If something tires you or if you tire, you feel that you have used a lot of energy and you want to rest or sleep.

words.tr: n. 大片土地；体内管道；
words.ex: The farmer owns a large tract of land near the river.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民拥有靠近河边的一大片土地。
words.en: A tract is a large area of land or a system of connected organs in the body.

words.ex: The workers dug a trench to lay the pipe.
words.ex_cn: 工人们挖了一条沟来铺设管道。
words.en: A trench is a long, narrow ditch. In warfare, trenches are dug by troops to provide shelter from enemy fire.

words.tr: n. [英]地铁；管子；管状物；电视机；
words.ex: I take the tube to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上乘地铁去上班。
words.en: A tube is a long, hollow cylinder used for conveying or holding liquids or gases.

words.ex: He will undertake a new project next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将从事一个新项目。
words.en: To undertake a task or job means to start doing it and accept responsibility for it.

words.ex: His answer was vague and hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答不明确，难以理解。
words.en: If something written or spoken is vague, it does not explain or express things clearly.

words.ex: The fishing vessel sailed out at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 那艘渔船在黎明时出海。
words.en: A vessel is a large boat or a container for holding liquids.

words.ex: The volcano erupted last year.
words.ex_cn: 这座火山去年喷发了。
words.en: A volcano is a mountain that opens downward to a pool of molten rock below the surface of the earth. When pressure builds up, eruptions occur.

words.ex: He wore a weird hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶怪异的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as weird, you mean that they are strange, unusual, or mysterious.

words.ex: She bought a warm wrap for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一件保暖的包裹（披肩）过冬。
words.en: To cover or enclose something in paper, cloth, or other material.

words.tr:
adj. 抽象的；非具体的；
n. 摘要；概要；抽象派艺术作品；
words.ex: The painting shows an abstract shape.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画展示了一个抽象的形状。
words.en: An abstract idea or way of thinking is based on general ideas rather than on real things and events.

words.ex: NASA is an acronym for National Aeronautics and Space Administration.
words.ex_cn: NASA 是美国国家航空航天局的缩写。
words.en: An acronym is a word formed from the initial letters of the words in a phrase, especially when this is used as a name.

words.tr: n. 搅动；煽动；激动；不安
words.ex: The agitation of the water made the dirt rise.
words.ex_cn: 水的搅动使灰尘浮起。
words.en: Agitation is a state of anxiety or nervous excitement.

words.ex: My ancestor came from China a hundred years ago.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖先一百年前来自中国。
words.en: An ancestor is a person from whom one is descended, typically more remote than a grandparent.

words.tr:
n. 北极地区；
adj. 北极的；
words.ex: Polar bears live in the arctic.
words.ex_cn: 北极熊生活在北极地区。
words.en: The Arctic is the area around the Earth's North Pole, characterized by cold temperatures and ice.

words.ex: He loves watching stars and learning astronomy.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢看星星并学习天文学。
words.en: Astronomy is the scientific study of celestial objects, space, and the physical universe as a whole.

words.ex: He changed his job because of his background.
words.ex_cn: 他因为自己的背景换了工作。
words.en: The background is the situation that exists at a particular time, or the situation in which something happens, which helps to explain it.

words.ex: The beacon shines at night to guide ships.
words.ex_cn: 灯塔在夜晚发光以引导船只。
words.en: A beacon is a light or a fire, usually on a hill or tower, which acts as a signal or a warning.

words.tr: n. 一阵强劲的气流；爆炸；
words.ex: A blast of cold wind hit the window.
words.ex_cn: 一阵冷风击中了窗户。
words.en: A blast is a sudden loud noise or a strong gust of wind. It can also refer to an explosion or the act of blowing something up. As a verb, it means to explode or to criticize severely.

words.tr: n. 崩溃；故障；细目分类；
words.ex: The stress led to a breakdown.
words.ex_cn: 压力导致了崩溃。
words.en: A breakdown is a failure of a system, machine, or relationship, or a sudden collapse in someone's mental health.

words.tr:
v. 挖洞；钻进；翻寻
n. 地洞
words.ex: The rabbit burrows under the tree.
words.ex_cn: 兔子在树下打洞。
words.en: A burrow is a hole or tunnel dug by a small animal, such as a rabbit or a mole, as a dwelling. As a verb, to burrow means to dig a hole or tunnel for habitation or refuge.

words.ex: He is capable of solving hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: If a person or thing is capable of doing something, they have the ability or potential to do it.

words.ex: The rain ceased after an hour.
words.ex_cn: 一小时后，雨停了。
words.en: If something ceases, it stops happening or existing.

words.tr:
n. 寒冷；寒意；
v. 变冷；使冰冷；
words.ex: The chill of the morning made me wear a jacket.
words.ex_cn: 早晨的寒冷让我穿上了夹克。
words.en: A chill is a feeling of coldness, often accompanied by shivering. It can also refer to a feeling of fear or anxiety. As a verb, to chill means to make something cold, or to relax and take it easy.

words.ex: I watched a clip of the movie on YouTube.
words.ex_cn: 我在YouTube上看了这部电影的一个片段。
words.en: A clip is a small device, usually made of metal or plastic, that is specially shaped for holding things together. As a verb, to clip means to cut something, especially to make it shorter or neater.

words.tr:
n. 通勤；
v. 通勤；
words.ex: His daily commute takes an hour by train.
words.ex_cn: 他每天的通勤坐火车要一个小时。
words.en: If you commute, you travel a long distance every day between your home and your place of work.

words.tr: n. 球果；松球；圆锥体；圆锥形物；
words.ex: The pine tree dropped a brown cone on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 松树掉下一个棕色的球果在地上。
words.en: A cone is a shape with a circular base that narrows to a point at the top.

words.tr:
n. 成分；
adj. 构成的；
words.ex: Sugar is a constituent of soda.
words.ex_cn: 糖是苏打水的一种成分。
words.en: A constituent is a part of a whole. In politics, a constituent is a person who is represented by an elected official.

words.ex: She coordinates the team's schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她协调团队的安排。
words.en: If you coordinate an activity, you organize the various people and things involved in it. If you coordinate the different parts of your body, you make them work together efficiently.

words.tr: adj. 至关重要的；批判性的；关键的；危急的；临界的；
words.ex: Water is critical for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you are critical of someone or something, you show that you disapprove of them. In a critical situation, things are very serious and dangerous. A critical time or event is extremely important because it will affect future events.

words.tr: adj. 大胆的；勇敢的； v. “dare”的现在分词；
words.ex: He made a daring jump off the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 他大胆地从桥上跳了下去。
words.en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as daring, you mean that they are willing to do things which might be dangerous or which might shock or anger other people.

words.ex: The Nile River forms a large delta before it flows into the sea.
words.ex_cn: 尼罗河在流入大海之前形成了一个巨大的三角洲。
words.en: A delta is an area of low, flat land shaped like a triangle, where a river splits and spreads out into several branches before entering the sea.

words.ex: The weather can dictate what we wear each day.
words.ex_cn: 天气可以支配我们每天穿什么。
words.en: To dictate means to say or read something aloud for someone else to write down, or to give orders in an authoritative manner.

words.ex: The news will disseminate quickly through social media.
words.ex_cn: 这条新闻会通过社交媒体迅速传播。
words.en: To disseminate means to spread or distribute something, especially information, widely.

words.tr:
adv. 向下；
prep. 沿…向下；
adj. 向下的；沮丧的；
words.ex: The ball fell down.
words.ex_cn: 球掉了下去。
words.en: Down is used to indicate movement from a higher to a lower position. It can also refer to a state of being less active or successful.

words.ex: He studies ecology to understand how animals live with plants.
words.ex_cn: 他学习生态学以了解动物如何与植物共存。
words.en: Ecology is the study of the relationships between living organisms, including humans, and their physical environment; it seeks to understand the vital connections between plants and animals and the world around them.

words.ex: He emphasizes the importance of homework.
words.ex_cn: 他强调作业的重要性。
words.en: To give special importance or prominence to (something) in speaking or writing.

words.ex: The enzyme helps break down food in the stomach.
words.ex_cn: 这种酶帮助分解胃里的食物。
words.en: An enzyme is a protein that acts as a catalyst to bring about a specific biochemical reaction.

words.ex: Workers excavate the old ruins with shovels.
words.ex_cn: 工人们用铲子挖掘古代遗址。
words.en: To excavate means to dig in the ground in order to find things that have been buried there, such as archaeological remains.

words.tr: adj. 灭绝的；熄灭的；绝种的；
words.ex: The dodo is an extinct bird.
words.ex_cn: 渡渡鸟是一种灭绝的鸟。
words.en: If a species of animals or plants is extinct, it no longer has any living members, either in the world or in a particular place.

words.tr: adj. 联邦的；联邦制的；联邦政府的；
words.ex: The federal government passed a new law.
words.ex_cn: 联邦政府通过了一项新法律。
words.en: A federal system of government is one in which there is a central government and separate governments for each of the states or regions.

words.ex: He will flee from the burning house.
words.ex_cn: 他会从着火的房子里逃走。
words.en: If you flee from something or someone, you leave them quickly because you are afraid of them or because you do not want to be involved with them.

words.ex: Parents should foster good habits in children.
words.ex_cn: 父母应该培养孩子的好习惯。
words.en: To foster something means to encourage and promote its development.

words.tr: v. 布置家具；配备；供给；提供
words.ex: He will furnish the apartment with new furniture.
words.ex_cn: 他将为公寓配备新家具。
words.en: To furnish a place means to put furniture and other things into it.

words.ex: He drew a geometric shape on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一个几何图形。
words.en: Relating to geometry, or according to its methods and principles.

words.ex: The cows graze in the field every morning.
words.ex_cn: 奶牛每天早上在田野里吃草。
words.en: To graze means to feed on grass or to touch something lightly in passing.

words.ex: The team worked in a harmonious way.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队以和谐的方式合作。
words.en: A harmonious situation, relationship, or agreement is one in which people are friendly and helpful to one another, and in which there is no serious disagreement or argument.

words.tr: n. 层次体系；等级制度；
words.ex: The company has a clear hierarchy from manager to worker.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司有一个从经理到员工的明确层次体系。
words.en: A hierarchy is a system in which people or things are arranged according to their importance.

words.ex: Hydrogen is the lightest element.
words.ex_cn: 氢是最轻的元素。
words.en: Hydrogen is a chemical element with symbol H and atomic number 1. With a standard atomic weight of 1.008, hydrogen is the lightest element in the periodic table.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.ex: Water is indispensable for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必不可少的。
words.en: Absolutely necessary or essential.

words.ex: The company values innovation in its products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司重视产品的创新。
words.en: Innovation is the introduction of new ideas, methods, or things.

words.ex: Don't interfere when I am working.
words.ex_cn: 我工作时不要打扰。
words.en: To interfere means to involve oneself in a situation where one is not wanted or needed, often causing problems or hindering progress.

words.ex: The ion moves quickly in the water.
words.ex_cn: 这个离子在水中快速移动。
words.en: An ion is an atom or molecule with a net electric charge due to the loss or gain of one or more electrons.

words.ex: The kernel of the computer is the operating system.
words.ex_cn: 计算机的核心是操作系统。
words.en: The kernel of something such as a nut or a seed is the part inside the shell. The kernel of an idea or a theory is the central and most important part of it.

words.ex: The layout of the room makes it feel bigger.
words.ex_cn: 房间的布局让它显得更大。
words.en: The way in which the parts of something are arranged or laid out.

words.ex: The graph shows a linear relationship between time and distance.
words.ex_cn: 这张图显示了时间与距离之间的线性关系。
words.en: Linear means involving or relating to a straight line or lines.

words.ex: The machine needs good lubrication to work smoothly.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器需要良好的润滑才能顺畅运行。
words.en: The process of applying a substance such as oil or grease to an engine or component so as to minimize friction and allow smooth movement.

words.tr:
n. 授权；任期；委任；命令
v. 授权；委任
words.ex: The government has a mandate from the people to change the law.
words.ex_cn: 政府得到了人民的授权来修改法律。
words.en: If someone is given a mandate to carry out a particular policy or task, they are given the official authority to do it.

words.ex: He wants to study medicine at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习医学。
words.en: Medicine is the science or practice of the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease.

words.ex: The bird flew in midair.
words.ex_cn: 鸟在空中飞翔。
words.en: If something happens in midair, it happens in the air, rather than on the ground.

words.ex: He will modify the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会更改计划。
words.en: To change something slightly, especially in order to make it more suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: His daily routine is mundane and boring.
words.ex_cn: 他的日常生活平凡而无聊。
words.en: Something that is mundane is very ordinary and not at all interesting or unusual.

words.ex: His neglect of the project caused delays.
words.ex_cn: 他对项目的疏忽导致了延误。
words.en: If you neglect someone or something, you fail to give them the attention or care that they need.

words.ex: The toy store sells many novelty items for children.
words.ex_cn: 玩具店出售许多为儿童设计的新奇物品。
words.en: The quality of being new, original, or unusual; something new, original, or unusual.

words.ex: The dogs had three offspring last spring.
words.ex_cn: 这些狗去年春天生了三只幼崽。
words.en: Someone's offspring are their children.

words.ex: The outbreak of the flu surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 流感的爆发让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: An outbreak of something unpleasant, such as violence or a disease, is a sudden occurrence of it.

words.ex: He made a painstaking effort to fix the small details.
words.ex_cn: 他细心地努力修正每一个小细节。
words.en: If you describe someone's work as painstaking, you mean that they do it very carefully and thoroughly, often taking a long time.

words.tr: n. 赞助人；资助人；老主顾
words.ex: The patron gave money to support the art exhibition.
words.ex_cn: 赞助人捐钱支持了这场艺术展览。
words.en: A patron is a person who supports with money, gifts, efforts, or endorsement an artist, musician, writer, form of art, or charitable cause.

words.tr: adj. 易腐烂的；易坏的；易毁灭的
words.ex: Milk is a perishable food.
words.ex_cn: 牛奶是一种易腐食品。
words.en: Likely to decay or go bad quickly.

words.ex: There is a pile of books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一堆书。
words.en: A pile of things is a quantity of them lying on top of one another. If you pile things somewhere, you put them there so that they form a pile.

words.tr:
v. 投入；跳入
n. 跳进；骤降
words.ex: He plunged into the cold water.
words.ex_cn: 他跳进了冰冷的水里。
words.en: If something or someone plunges in a particular direction, especially into water, they fall, rush, or throw themselves in that direction.

words.ex: Farmers use potash to make soil better for crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用钾肥来改善土壤以利于作物生长。
words.en: Potash is a potassium compound, often used in fertilizers to improve plant growth and soil quality.

words.ex: He has prejudice against people from other countries.
words.ex_cn: 他对来自其他国家的人有偏见。
words.en: Prejudice is an unreasonable dislike of a particular group of people or things, or a preference for one group of people or things over another.

words.tr:
n. 探测器；
v. 探查；
words.ex: The probe sent back photos from Mars.
words.ex_cn: 探测器从火星传回了照片。
words.en: If you probe into something, you ask questions or try to discover facts about it. A probe is also a long thin instrument that doctors and dentists use to examine parts of the body.

words.tr: n. 支持者；拥护者；辩护者
words.ex: He is a proponent of clean energy.
words.ex_cn: 他是清洁能源的支持者。
words.en: A proponent of an idea or course of action is someone who supports it and tries to persuade other people to support it.

words.tr:
v. 拉；拖；牵；拔；
n. 拉；拖；牵；拔；
words.ex: He pull the door open.
words.ex_cn: 他拉开了门。
words.en: To pull something means to use your hands to make it move towards you or in the direction that your hands are moving.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.ex: The movie shows realism by depicting everyday life honestly.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影通过真实地描绘日常生活展现现实主义。
words.en: Realism is the quality or fact of representing a person, thing, or situation accurately or in a way that is true to life.

words.ex: We recycle plastic bottles every week.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周回收塑料瓶。
words.en: To recycle means to process used materials so that they can be used again.

words.ex: The queen's reign lasted 70 years.
words.ex_cn: 女王的统治持续了70年。
words.en: The period during which a sovereign rules; to hold royal office; to prevail

words.ex: The rental of the apartment costs $800 per month.
words.ex_cn: 这套公寓的租赁费用是每月800美元。
words.en: The act of paying for the use of something, such as property, a vehicle, or equipment, or the amount paid for such use.

words.ex: The residue left in the cup was sugar.
words.ex_cn: 杯子里留下的残留物是糖。
words.en: A residue of something is a small amount that remains after the main part has gone or been taken or used.

words.ex: He revised his answer to make it correct.
words.ex_cn: 他修正了他的答案，使其正确。
words.en: To revise something means to alter or amend it, especially in order to correct or improve it.

words.ex: The rodent ran quickly across the floor.
words.ex_cn: 这只啮齿动物迅速跑过地板。
words.en: A rodent is a small mammal which has sharp front teeth that it uses for gnawing. Rodents include rats, mice, and squirrels.

words.tr:
v. 航行；驾（船）；
n. 帆；航行；航海；
words.ex: They sail to the island every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他们每年夏天都乘船航行到那个岛。
words.en: To sail means to travel on water in a ship or boat, especially one that uses sails to catch the wind.

words.tr:
n. 侦察兵；
v. 搜寻；
words.ex: The scout watched the enemy's movement quietly.
words.ex_cn: 侦察兵悄悄观察敌人的动向。
words.en: A scout is someone who is sent to an area of countryside to find out the position of an enemy or to search for a suitable place for a military camp.

words.ex: The school used to segregate students by race.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校过去按种族隔离学生。
words.en: To segregate means to separate one group of people, animals, or things from another, especially because they are of different types or belong to different categories.

words.tr: adj. 锋利的；骤变的；灵敏的；尖刻的；
words.ex: The knife is sharp enough to cut paper.
words.ex_cn: 这把刀足够锋利，可以切纸。
words.en: Having a thin edge or a fine point that is capable of cutting or piercing; keen.

words.ex: The significance of this discovery changed science.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现的重要性改变了科学。
words.en: The quality of being worthy of attention; importance.

words.tr:
adj. 平滑的；平坦的；
v. 使平滑；
words.ex: The glass surface is smooth.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃表面是平滑的。
words.en: Having an even and regular surface or consistency; free from projections, indentations, or roughness.

words.tr:
v. 抽出；节省；
adj. 备用的；多余的；空闲的；
words.ex: Can you spare a few minutes to help me?
words.ex_cn: 你能抽出几分钟帮我吗？
words.en: If you have something such as time, money, or space to spare, you have some extra time, money, or space that you have not used or which you do not need.

words.tr:
v. 分开；分裂；
n. 划分；分歧；
words.ex: The tree split in the storm.
words.ex_cn: 那棵树在风暴中裂开了。
words.en: If something splits or if you split it, it is divided into two or more parts.

words.ex: He bought a stake in the new company.
words.ex_cn: 他购买了这家新公司的股份。
words.en: A stake is a pointed stick or post that is pushed into the ground, for example to support a young tree. It can also refer to a share or interest in a business, situation, or system.

words.ex: His neck was stiff after sleeping wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他睡姿不对，脖子变得僵硬。
words.en: If something is stiff, it is firm and does not bend easily. It can also describe a person who is not relaxed or friendly.

words.ex: My teacher is strict about homework deadlines.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师对作业截止日期要求很严格。
words.en: If someone is strict, they behave firmly and make sure that rules are obeyed.

words.tr:
n. 代用品；代替物；
v. 替代；
words.ex: Honey is a good substitute for sugar.
words.ex_cn: 蜂蜜是糖的良好代用品。
words.en: A substitute is something or someone that takes the place or function of another.

words.ex: The movie shows a supernatural ghost.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了一个超自然的幽灵。
words.en: Relating to phenomena that cannot be explained by natural laws and are therefore attributed to a divine agency.

words.tr:
adj. 迅速的；敏捷的；快的；
n. 雨燕；
words.ex: The swift runner won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位迅速的跑步者赢得了比赛。
words.en: moving or capable of moving at great speed, or happening within a very short time; fast.

words.tr:
v. 利用；
n. 水龙头；轻拍；轻敲；轻击；
words.ex: The company tapped local talent to grow its business.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司利用本地人才来发展业务。
words.en: If you tap something, you hit it with a quick light blow or a series of quick light blows. A tap is a device that controls the flow of a liquid or gas from a pipe or container, for example on a sink.

words.ex: Many families live in a small tenement in the city.
words.ex_cn: 许多家庭住在城市里的一间廉价公寓里。
words.en: A tenement is a large old building which is divided into a number of individual flats.

words.ex: The political issue is thorny and hard to solve.
words.ex_cn: 这个政治问题很棘手，难以解决。
words.en: A thorny problem or subject is difficult to deal with because it is complex and involves many different aspects.

words.ex: The doctor examined the tissue under a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 医生在显微镜下检查了组织。
words.en: Tissue is a group of cells that have a similar structure and that work together to perform a specific function.

words.ex: He wears traditional clothes on holidays.
words.ex_cn: 他在节日时穿传统服装。
words.en: Traditional refers to customs, beliefs, or methods that have existed for a long time without changing.

words.ex: The trend shows more people are using electric cars.
words.ex_cn: 这个趋势表明越来越多的人在使用电动汽车。
words.en: A trend is a general development or change in a situation or in the way that people are behaving.

words.tr:
v. 跌倒；摔倒；暴跌
n. 摔倒；混乱；暴跌
words.ex: The child tumble down the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 孩子从楼梯上跌倒了。
words.en: If someone or something tumbles, they fall quickly and suddenly, often turning over or spinning as they fall.

words.tr:
adj. 一致的；统一的；
n. 制服；
words.ex: The students wear a uniform shirt to school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们穿一致的衬衫去学校。
words.en: A uniform is a special set of clothes which some people, for example soldiers or the police, wear to work in and which some children wear at school. It is also used to describe something that is the same in all parts and does not vary.

words.ex: This coupon is valid until next month.
words.ex_cn: 这张优惠券到下个月都有效。
words.en: If something such as a document or agreement is valid, it is legally acceptable or officially recognized.

words.ex: The old house has a vestige of its original design.
words.ex_cn: 这座老房子还保留着它原始设计的痕迹。
words.en: A vestige is a small part or amount of something that remains after the rest has disappeared or been destroyed.

words.ex: The battery gives out 9 volts.
words.ex_cn: 这节电池输出9伏特。
words.en: A volt is a unit used to measure the force of an electric current.

words.ex: The government provides welfare to poor families.
words.ex_cn: 政府向贫困家庭提供福利。
words.en: The welfare of a person or group is their health, comfort, and happiness.

words.tr:
n. 遇难船只；残骸；
v. 破坏；毁坏；
words.ex: The wreck lies at the bottom of the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这艘遇难船只沉在海底。
words.en: If something such as a ship or a plane is wrecked, it is damaged so much that it cannot be repaired or it is completely destroyed.

words.tr: adj. 荒唐的；荒唐可笑的；
words.ex: It's absurd to wear a coat in summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天穿外套是荒唐的。
words.en: If you say that something is absurd, you are criticizing it because you think that it is ridiculous or that it does not make sense.

words.tr: adj. 敏锐的；急性的；严重的；
words.ex: He has an acute mind and solves problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他思维敏锐，能快速解决问题。
words.en: An acute problem or negative feeling is very severe.

words.tr: adj. 同族的；同类的；类似的
words.ex: The two stories are akin in theme.
words.ex_cn: 这两个故事在主题上是同族的。
words.en: If one thing is akin to another, it is similar to it in some way.

words.ex: The angle of the roof helps rain run off.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶的角度有助于雨水流下。
words.en: An angle is the space between two lines or surfaces that meet, measured in degrees.

words.ex: The arid land has little rain and no trees.
words.ex_cn: 这片干旱的土地降雨稀少，没有树木。
words.en: An arid area of land has so little rain that it is very dry and cannot support much vegetation.

words.ex: He is an astute businessman who always makes smart decisions.
