words.en: A shelf is a flat piece of wood, metal, or glass which is attached to a wall or to the sides of a cupboard. Shelves are used for keeping things on.

words.ex: A sliver of wood stuck in his finger.
words.ex_cn: 一小片木头扎进了他的手指。
words.en: A sliver is a small, thin piece of something that has been cut, broken, or torn off from a larger piece.

words.ex: A snowflake falls gently from the sky.
words.ex_cn: 一片雪花轻轻从天空飘落。
words.en: A snowflake is a single ice crystal that has achieved a sufficient size, and may have amalgamated with others, which falls through the Earth's atmosphere as snow.

words.ex: The fish spawn in the river each spring.
words.ex_cn: 鱼每年春天在河里产卵。
words.en: To spawn means to produce or deposit eggs, especially in large quantities, as fish, frogs, etc. do. It can also mean to give rise to or generate something.

words.tr: adj. 自发的；自然产生的；
words.ex: The children gave a spontaneous cheer.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们自发地欢呼起来。
words.en: Something that is spontaneous is not planned but happens or is done because of a sudden impulse or natural feeling.

words.tr: adj. 令人吃惊的； v. “startle”的现在分词；
words.ex: The news was startling to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个消息让所有人都感到吃惊。
words.en: Something that is startling is so surprising, unexpected, or remarkable that it makes you feel slightly shocked.

words.ex: Please stir the soup before serving.
words.ex_cn: 请在上菜前搅拌一下汤。
words.en: To mix a substance or move it around using a spoon or other object; to cause to move or act; to arouse or excite.

words.ex: He strives to finish his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力完成作业。
words.en: If you strive to do something or strive for something, you make a great effort to do it or get it.

words.ex: They live in a quiet suburb outside the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市外一个安静的市郊。
words.en: A suburb is a residential district located on the outskirts of a city.

words.ex: I suppose he is late because of the traffic.
words.ex_cn: 我认为他因为交通堵塞而迟到了。
words.en: If you suppose that something is true, you believe or imagine that it is true, although you may not have any proof.

words.ex: The dove is a symbol of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征。
words.en: A symbol is a shape or design that is used to represent something such as an idea, a quality, or a process.

words.tr:
n. 味觉；味道；品味；喜好；
v. 品尝；有…味道；
words.ex: My taste can detect sweet and sour flavors.
words.ex_cn: 我的味觉能分辨甜味和酸味。
words.en: The sensation of flavor perceived in the mouth and throat on contact with a substance.

words.ex: The bus stops at the terminal at 9 PM.
words.ex_cn: 公交车晚上9点到达终点站。
words.en: A terminal is a place where vehicles, passengers, or goods begin or end a journey. It can also refer to a computer device at which a user enters data or commands.

words.ex: She picked up a thread from the fabric.
words.ex_cn: 她从布料上捡起一根线。
words.en: A thread is a long, thin strand of cotton, nylon, or other fibers used in sewing or weaving. It can also refer to a theme or idea that connects parts of a story or discussion.

words.tr:
n. 脚趾
v. 用脚尖触
words.ex: He touched the ball with his toe.
words.ex_cn: 他用脚趾碰了球。
words.en: One of the five digits at the end of the foot, or the similar part of a shoe or sock.

words.ex: Honesty is a good trait.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一种好的特性。
words.en: A trait is a particular characteristic, quality, or tendency that someone or something has.

words.ex: The small river flows into the main river as a tributary.
words.ex_cn: 这条小河作为支流汇入主河。
words.en: A tributary is a stream or river that flows into a larger stream or main stem (or parent) river or a lake. A tributary does not flow directly into a sea or ocean.

words.ex: He drove on the turnpike to save time.
words.ex_cn: 他走收费公路以节省时间。
words.en: A turnpike is a road that drivers must pay to use, especially in the past. It is also a gate or barrier set across a road to stop traffic until a toll is paid.

words.ex: This rule is universal for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则对所有学生都是普遍适用的。
words.en: Something that is universal affects or relates to every part of the world or the universe.

words.tr:
adj. 可变的；易变的；
n. 变量；
words.ex: The weather is variable in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天的天气是多变的。
words.en: A variable is something that is likely to vary; something that is subject to variation.

words.ex: The children are vibrant and full of energy.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们充满活力。
words.en: If you describe something as vibrant, you mean that it is bright, lively, and full of energy.

words.tr: n. 四轮运货马车；敞篷货车；
words.ex: The farmer used a wooden wagon to carry crops.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用一辆木制四轮运货马车运送庄稼。
words.en: A wagon is a vehicle with four wheels, usually pulled by horses or oxen, used for transporting goods.

words.ex: He likes coffee, whereas she prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，然而她更喜欢茶。
words.en: You use whereas to introduce a comment which contrasts with what is said in the main clause.

words.ex: He yearns for a better life.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望更好的生活。
words.en: If you yearn for something, you want it very much.

words.ex: The car will accelerate when you press the gas.
words.ex_cn: 当你踩油门时，汽车会加速。
words.en: To accelerate means to start to go faster or to make something start to go faster.

words.tr:
n. 附属物；
adj. 附属的；
words.ex: The printer is an adjunct to the computer.
words.ex_cn: 打印机是电脑的附属物。
words.en: Something that is added or attached to something else but is not essential to it.

words.ex: Lye is a strong alkali used in cleaning.
words.ex_cn: 氢氧化钠是一种用于清洁的强碱。
words.en: An alkali is a chemical compound that neutralizes acids to form salts and turns red litmus paper blue.

words.ex: He is studying anthropology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学里学习人类学。
words.en: Anthropology is the study of human societies and cultures and their development.

words.ex: The police arrested the thief last night.
words.ex_cn: 警察昨晚逮捕了那个小偷。
words.en: If the police arrest you, they take charge of you and take you to a police station, because they believe you may have committed a crime.

words.tr:
v. 把…归因于；由…引起；
n. 品质；属性；特征；属性；
words.ex: He attributes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归因于努力工作。
words.en: If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation.

words.ex: She practices ballet every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 她每天下午练习芭蕾舞。
words.en: Ballet is a type of performance dance that originated during the Italian Renaissance in the 15th century and later developed into a concert dance form in France and Russia. It has since become a widespread, highly technical form of dance with its own vocabulary based on French terminology. It has been globally influential and has defined the foundational techniques used in many other dance genres.

words.ex: The child behaves well in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子在课堂上表现得很好。
words.en: To behave means to act in a particular way, especially in a way that is good or correct.

words.tr:
v. 吹；打击；
n. 打击；
words.ex: The wind blows the leaves away.
words.ex_cn: 风吹走了树叶。
words.en: To move air or gas forcefully; to strike something with force.

words.tr:
adj. 简短的；简明的；短暂的；
v. 为…提供信息；
n. 摘要；概要；
words.ex: He gave a brief answer.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了一个简短的答案。
words.en: If something is brief, it lasts only for a short time.

words.ex: The cable connects the computer to the printer.
words.ex_cn: 这条电缆将电脑连接到打印机。
words.en: A cable is a thick wire or rope, or a bundle of wires or ropes, used to carry electricity or electronic signals, or to support a structure.

words.ex: Lions are carnivores that eat meat.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是吃肉的食肉动物。
words.en: A carnivore is an animal that eats the flesh of other animals.

words.ex: He keeps apples in the cellar.
words.ex_cn: 他把苹果存放在地窖里。
words.en: A cellar is a room underneath a house, often used for storing things such as wine or coal.

words.ex: The guitarist played a C major chord.
words.ex_cn: 吉他手弹了一个C大和弦。
words.en: A chord is a group of three or more musical notes played together.

words.ex: The sandpaper feels coarse to the touch.
words.ex_cn: 这张砂纸摸起来很粗糙。
words.en: Coarse things have a rough texture because they consist of thick threads or large pieces.

words.tr:
v. 补充；与…相辅相成；
n. 补足物；补语；余角；
words.ex: The red scarf complements her blue coat.
words.ex_cn: 这条红围巾补充了她的蓝外套。
words.en: To complement something means to make it complete or perfect by adding something to it.

words.ex: The test results confirm he has the disease.
words.ex_cn: 检测结果证实他患有这种疾病。
words.en: To confirm something means to establish its truth or validity by providing evidence or proof.

words.tr: adj. 现代的；当代的；同时代的；
words.ex: This museum displays contemporary art.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆展示现代艺术。
words.en: Belonging to or occurring in the present; or a person or thing living or existing at the same time as another.

words.tr:
n. 核；核心；重点；
adj. 核心的；
words.ex: The core of the apple is not edible.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的核心不能吃。
words.en: The central or most important part of something.

words.tr: adj. 至关重要的；决定性的；
words.ex: It is crucial to drink water every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天喝水至关重要。
words.en: If you describe something as crucial, you mean it is extremely important.

words.ex: The storm left debris on the road.
words.ex_cn: 风暴在道路上留下了碎片。
words.en: The remains of something that has been destroyed or broken up.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.tr:
adj. 暗淡的；昏暗的；模糊的
v. （使）变暗淡；（使）变模糊；（使）减弱
words.ex: The room is dim because the lights are off.
words.ex_cn: 房间很暗，因为灯关了。
words.en: If a light or a place is dim, it is not bright or is not lit very strongly.

words.ex: The mirror distorts my face.
words.ex_cn: 这面镜子扭曲了我的脸。
words.en: If you distort a statement, fact, or idea, you report or represent it in an untrue way.

words.tr:
n. 流动；
v. 漂移；
words.ex: The drift of the river carries leaves downstream.
words.ex_cn: 河流的流动将树叶冲向下游。
words.en: If something or someone drifts somewhere, they move there slowly or gradually. As a noun, drift can refer to a slow, gradual movement or change, or the general meaning or intent of something.

words.ex: The electron moves around the nucleus.
words.ex_cn: 电子围绕原子核运动。
words.en: An electron is a tiny particle with a negative charge that is found in all atoms and plays a key role in electricity.

words.tr:
n. 尽力；尝试；
v. 尽力；奋力；
words.ex: His endeavor to finish the project took all his energy.
words.ex_cn: 他为完成这个项目付出了全部努力。
words.en: An endeavor is an attempt to do something, especially something new or original.

words.ex: The school will equip the lab with new computers.
words.ex_cn: 学校将为实验室配备新电脑。
words.en: To provide someone or something with the necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He exerted pressure on his team to win.
words.ex_cn: 他给他的团队施加了压力以赢得比赛。
words.en: To exert means to use power, influence, or effort to make something happen.

words.tr: n. 织物；（建筑物的）结构；
words.ex: The dress is made of soft fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子是由柔软的织物制成的。
words.en: Fabric refers to cloth or other material produced by weaving together cotton, nylon, wool, silk, or other threads. It can also refer to the basic structure of a building or a system.

words.ex: His fidelity to his friend never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友的忠诚从未改变。
words.en: Fidelity is loyalty to a person, organization, or set of beliefs.

words.tr:
n. 洪水；水灾；
v. 淹没；泛滥；
words.ex: The heavy rain caused a flood in the village.
words.ex_cn: 大雨导致了村庄发生洪水。
words.en: A flood is an overflow of water that submerges land which is usually dry. In the sense of 'flowing water', the word may also be applied to the inflow of the tide.

words.ex: The glass broke into small fragments.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃碎成了小碎片。
words.en: A fragment of something is a small piece or part of it.

words.tr: n. 伽马（希腊字母表的第3个字母γ）
words.ex: The gamma ray came from the sun.
words.ex_cn: 伽马射线来自太阳。
words.en: The third letter of the Greek alphabet (Γ, γ), transliterated as 'g'. In physics, gamma rays are a form of electromagnetic radiation of high frequency and therefore high energy.

words.ex: The glacial landscape was covered in snow.
words.ex_cn: 冰河地貌被雪覆盖着。
words.en: relating to, resulting from, or denoting the presence or agency of ice, especially in the form of glaciers.

words.ex: The students gathered in the hall for the assembly.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在大厅里集合。
words.en: A hall is a large room or building which is used for public events such as concerts, exhibitions, and meetings.

words.ex: The memory of the accident still haunts him.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故的记忆仍然长期困扰着他。
words.en: If something unpleasant haunts you, you keep thinking or worrying about it over a long period of time. A place that is haunted is believed to be visited regularly by a ghost.

words.ex: The tree has a hollow trunk.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树的树干是中空的。
words.en: If something is hollow, it has an empty space inside it.

words.tr:
adj. 理想的；
n. 理想；典范；
words.ex: This is the ideal place to relax.
words.ex_cn: 这是放松的理想地方。
words.en: An ideal is a principle or value that one actively pursues as a goal, often in the context of ethics or morality.

words.tr: adj. 不能渗透的；不受影响的
words.ex: The coat is impervious to rain.
words.ex_cn: 这件外套不透水。
words.en: If you are impervious to someone's actions, you are not affected or influenced by them.

words.tr: v. 大批出没于；成群滋扰；遍布于；寄生
words.ex: The bugs infest the old house.
words.ex_cn: 这些虫子侵袭了这栋老房子。
words.en: If creatures such as insects or rats infest a place, they are present in large numbers and usually cause damage or disease.

words.ex: Her story inspires me to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 她的故事激励我更加努力。
words.en: If someone or something inspires you to do something new or unusual, they make you want to do it.

words.ex: There is a five-minute interval between the two classes.
words.ex_cn: 两节课之间有五分钟的间隔。
words.en: An interval is a period of time between two events or dates.

words.ex: Farmers irrigate their fields with water from the river.
words.ex_cn: 农民用河里的水灌溉他们的田地。
words.en: To supply land or crops with water by means of channels or pipes.

words.ex: The lion is the king of the animal kingdom.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是动物王国之王。
words.en: A kingdom is a country or region that is ruled by a king or queen.

words.ex: The cat sat on the ledge of the window.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在窗户的架状突出物上。
words.en: A ledge is a narrow horizontal surface projecting from a wall, cliff, or other surface.

words.ex: He is literally the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他确实是队里最好的球员。
words.en: In a literal manner or sense; exactly.

words.ex: He has a bad lung infection.
words.ex_cn: 他得了严重的肺部感染。
words.en: Your lungs are the two organs inside your chest which fill with air when you breathe in.

words.tr:
adj. 手工的；体力的；
n. 说明书；
words.ex: He made a manual copy of the letter.
words.ex_cn: 他手工抄写了一封信。
words.en: A manual is a book which tells you how to do something or how a piece of machinery works.

words.tr: adj. 值得纪念的；难忘的；
words.ex: That vacation was a memorable trip.
words.ex_cn: 那次旅行是一次值得纪念的旅程。
words.en: Something that is memorable is worth remembering or likely to be remembered, because it is special or very enjoyable.

words.ex: The millennium began in the year 2000.
words.ex_cn: 一千年始于2000年。
words.en: A millennium is a period of one thousand years.

words.ex: He waited for a moment before speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他等了一会儿才开口。
words.en: A moment is a very short period of time.

words.tr:
adj. 无数的；
n. 无数；
words.ex: There are myriad stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中有无数的星星。
words.en: A myriad of things or people is a very large number of them.

words.ex: He stayed neutral in the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争论中保持中立。
words.en: If you say that someone is neutral, you mean that they do not support or help either side in a disagreement, competition, or war.

words.ex: Eating vegetables gives you good nutrition.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜能提供良好的营养。
words.en: The process of providing or obtaining the food necessary for health and growth.

words.tr: v. 运转；操作；施行手术；
words.ex: The machine operates smoothly.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器运转顺畅。
words.en: If you operate a business or organization, you work to keep it running properly. If a business or organization operates, it carries out its work.

words.tr: adj. 边远的；偏远的；远离市镇的
words.ex: The outlying village has no bus service.
words.ex_cn: 这个偏远的村庄没有公交车服务。
words.en: Situated far from a center or main area.

words.ex: It's a paradox that he is rich but unhappy.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个悖论，他很富有却不快乐。
words.en: A paradox is a statement that seems to contradict itself but may nonetheless be true, or a situation that defies intuition.

words.ex: This town has a peculiar custom of dancing at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇有一个独特的午夜跳舞习俗。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as peculiar, you think that they are strange or unusual, sometimes in an unpleasant way.

words.ex: His personality is very friendly and outgoing.
words.ex_cn: 他的个性非常友好和外向。
words.en: The combination of characteristics or qualities that form an individual's distinctive character.

words.tr:
n. 枢；中心；旋转
v. 在枢轴上转动；以…为中心
words.ex: The door pivots on a hinge.
words.ex_cn: 门围绕一个铰链旋转。
words.en: A pivot is the central point, pin, or shaft on which a mechanism turns or oscillates. It can also refer to the central or most important person or thing in a situation.

words.tr: adj. 抛光的；磨光的；擦亮的； v. 擦亮；磨光；“polish”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The polished table reflected the light.
words.ex_cn: 抛光的桌子反射着光线。
words.en: If something is polished, it has been made smooth and shiny by rubbing it with a cloth or a special substance.

words.ex: He spilled powder on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把粉末撒在了地上。
words.en: A powder is a dry substance made up of very small particles. It can be used for various purposes, including cosmetics, cleaning, and cooking. As a verb, to powder means to apply or cover something with powder.

words.ex: The university has great prestige for its research.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学因其研究而享有很高的声望。
words.en: The widespread respect and admiration felt for someone or something on the basis of a perception of their achievements or quality.

words.tr:
v. 生产；制造；导致；引起；生育；出示；
n. 农产品；
words.ex: The farm produces fresh vegetables every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场每天生产新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: To produce something means to make, create, or manufacture it, often in large quantities. It can also refer to the act of causing something to happen or exist.

words.ex: The prospect of a better job makes him happy.
words.ex_cn: 更好工作的前景让他感到高兴。
words.en: A prospect is the possibility that something will happen, or a view of a wide area.

words.ex: The purification of water removes harmful bacteria.
words.ex_cn: 水的净化可以去除有害细菌。
words.en: The act of making something pure by removing dirty or harmful substances.

words.ex: The train runs on the rail.
words.ex_cn: 火车在铁轨上行驶。
words.en: A rail is a horizontal bar, typically made of metal or wood, used as a support or barrier; or a track made of steel rails along which trains run.

words.tr: v. 重新排列；重新安排
words.ex: He rearranged the books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书架上的书重新排列了。
words.en: If you rearrange the objects in a place, you change the way in which they are organized or positioned.

words.ex: He didn't refer to the book during the talk.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中没有提到那本书。
words.en: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them. If you refer to someone or something as a particular thing, you use a particular word, expression, or name to mention or describe them.

words.ex: This information is relevant to our project.
words.ex_cn: 这些信息与我们的项目相关。
words.en: Something that is relevant to a situation or person is important or significant in that situation or to that person.

words.ex: The theater's repertory includes classic plays and modern dramas.
words.ex_cn: 这家剧院的全部剧目包括经典戏剧和现代戏剧。
words.en: A repertory is a collection of pieces of music or plays that a company or performer knows or is prepared to perform.

words.tr:
n. 度假胜地；手段；
v. 求助于；
words.ex: They went to a beach resort for their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们去一个海滨度假胜地度假。
words.en: If you resort to a particular course of action, you do it because you cannot see any other way of achieving what you want.

words.ex: The rhinoceros walks slowly in the grass.
words.ex_cn: 犀牛在草地上慢慢行走。
words.en: A rhinoceros is a large, thick-skinned animal with one or two horns on its nose, native to Africa and southern Asia.

words.ex: The wheel rotates slowly.
words.ex_cn: 轮子缓慢地转动。
words.en: To rotate means to turn or cause to turn around an axis or center.

words.tr: n. 公共卫生；卫生设施；
words.ex: The city improved sanitation to keep people healthy.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改善了公共卫生以保障人民健康。
words.en: The conditions and processes that help maintain health and prevent disease, especially through cleanliness.

words.tr:
n. 顾虑；顾忌；踌躇
v. 顾虑；有顾忌
words.ex: He had a scruple about lying to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他对于对朋友撒谎感到不安。
words.en: A scruple is a feeling of doubt or hesitation with regard to the morality or propriety of a course of action.

words.ex: The sensory experience of eating chocolate is wonderful.
words.ex_cn: 吃巧克力的感觉体验很棒。
words.en: Sensory means relating to the physical senses of touch, smell, taste, hearing, and sight.

words.ex: The knight held up his shield to block the arrow.
words.ex_cn: 骑士举起盾牌来挡箭。
words.en: A shield is a piece of armor held in the hand or worn on the arm to protect the body from missiles or blows. It can also refer to something that protects or defends someone or something from harm or danger.

words.ex: The two events happened simultaneously.
words.ex_cn: 这两个事件同时发生了。
words.en: Happening, existing, or done at the same time.

words.ex: He washes his hands with soap.
words.ex_cn: 他用肥皂洗手。
words.en: A substance used with water for washing and cleaning, made of a compound of natural oils or fats with sodium hydroxide or another strong alkali, and typically also perfume and coloring.

words.ex: This restaurant is famous for its specialty, fried dumplings.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅以特色菜煎饺而闻名。
words.en: A specialty is a particular area of study or expertise that someone has, or a product that is particularly associated with a specific place.

words.ex: He picked up a spoon to eat the soup.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起一把勺子喝汤。
words.en: A spoon is an object used for eating, stirring, and serving food. It has a small shallow bowl on a handle.

words.ex: The children starve without food.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们没有食物就会挨饿。
words.en: To suffer or die from lack of food.

words.tr:
n. 针脚；缝线；一针
v. 缝；缝合
words.ex: She sews a stitch to fix the tear.
words.ex_cn: 她缝一针来补破洞。
words.en: A stitch is a piece of thread that has been used to sew the edges of a wound together. It can also refer to a loop of thread or yarn resulting from a single pass or movement of the needle in sewing, knitting, or crocheting.

words.tr: n. 中风；划水动作；一击；
words.ex: He had a stroke last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年中风了。
words.en: A stroke is a medical condition in which poor blood flow to the brain results in cell death. It can also refer to an act of hitting or striking someone or something, or a gentle movement of the hand over a surface.

words.ex: I take the subway to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天坐地铁去上班。
words.en: An underground railway system in a city, usually operated by electricity, which provides a rapid means of transportation.

words.ex: The supreme leader makes the final decision.
words.ex_cn: 至上的领导人做出最终决定。
words.en: If you say that something is supreme, you mean that it is the most important or the best of its kind.

words.ex: The butterfly is symmetrical.
words.ex_cn: 这只蝴蝶是对称的。
words.en: Something that is symmetrical has parts that are equal in size, shape, and position, and that are arranged in a balanced way.

words.ex: He drank beer in a small tavern.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小酒馆里喝啤酒。
words.en: A tavern is a place where alcoholic drinks are served and people gather to drink and socialize.

words.ex: The house has a small terrace with chairs.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有一个带椅子的小平台。
words.en: A terrace is a flat area of stone or grass next to a building where people can sit.

words.ex: The storm is a threat to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对村庄构成了威胁。
words.en: A threat is a statement of an intention to inflict pain, injury, damage, or other hostile action on someone in retribution for something done or not done.

words.ex: His tolerance for different opinions is impressive.
words.ex_cn: 他对不同观点的宽容令人印象深刻。
words.en: The ability or willingness to tolerate the existence of opinions or behaviour that one dislikes or disagrees with.

words.tr: adj. 安静的；平静的；宁静的；
words.ex: The lake was tranquil in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早晨的湖面很安静。
words.en: If a place or situation is tranquil, it is calm, peaceful, and quiet, with no disturbance or agitation.

words.ex: He showed me the trick to solve this math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他给我展示了快速解决这道数学题的诀窍。
words.en: A trick is a clever or deceitful action intended to deceive or outwit someone.

words.ex: The turtle walks slowly on the sand.
words.ex_cn: 乌龟在沙子上慢慢走。
words.en: A turtle is a reptile with a hard shell that lives in the sea or on land.

words.ex: You won't pass the test unless you study.
words.ex_cn: 除非你学习，否则你不会通过考试。
words.en: You use unless to introduce the only circumstances in which an event you are mentioning will not take place or in which a statement you are making is not true.

words.tr: n. （同一事物）不同种类；多样性；（动植物的）品种；变化；
words.ex: The store sells a variety of apples.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种各样的苹果。
words.en: If something has variety, it consists of things which are different from each other.

words.ex: The phone vibrates when it receives a call.
words.ex_cn: 当手机收到电话时，它会震动。
words.en: To vibrate means to move rapidly to and fro or up and down; to oscillate.

words.ex: He likes to wander in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢晚饭后在公园里徘徊。
words.en: If you wander in a place, you walk around there in a casual way, often without intending to go in any particular direction or to any particular place.

words.ex: He whittled a small bird from wood.
words.ex_cn: 他用木头削出了一只小鸟。
words.en: To whittle means to cut or shape a piece of wood by repeatedly cutting small slices from it, or to reduce something in size, amount, or extent by a gradual series of steps.

words.tr:
v. 生产；获利；
n. 产量；
words.ex: This farm yields a lot of wheat each year.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场每年生产大量小麦。
words.en: If you yield to someone or something, you stop resisting them. If a tree or plant yields fruit or flowers, it produces them.

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

words.ex: He administers the school daily.
words.ex_cn: 他每天管理这所学校。
words.en: To administrate means to manage and be responsible for the running of a business, organization, etc.

words.ex: The alligator swims slowly in the river.
words.ex_cn: 鳄鱼在河里慢慢游动。
words.en: An alligator is a large reptile with a long body, thick skin, and a long tail, living in the water and on land in the hot wet parts of America and China.

words.ex: The doctor gave me an antibiotic for my infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了抗菌素治疗感染。
words.en: A substance that can kill or inhibit the growth of bacteria and other microorganisms.

words.ex: The artery carries blood from the heart.
words.ex_cn: 动脉将血液从心脏输送到身体。
words.en: An artery is a tube that carries blood from the heart to the rest of the body.

words.ex: The auditory system helps us hear sounds.
words.ex_cn: 听觉系统帮助我们听到声音。
words.en: Relating to the sense of hearing.

words.ex: The fish has a sharp barb on its tail.
words.ex_cn: 这条鱼的尾巴上有一个尖锐的倒刺。
words.en: A barb is a sharp projection near the end of an arrow, fishhook, or similar object, which is angled away from the main point so as to make extraction difficult. It can also refer to a remark that is meant to hurt someone's feelings.

words.ex: His belief in honesty never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对诚实的信念从未改变。
words.en: A belief is a strong feeling that something is true or exists.

words.tr: v. 自夸；夸耀；自豪地拥有
words.ex: He boasts about his new car.
words.ex_cn: 他夸耀自己的新车。
words.en: If someone boasts about something that they have done or that they own, they talk about it very proudly, in a way that other people may find irritating or offensive.

words.ex: The brilliance of the sun made the sky bright.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的光辉让天空变得明亮。
words.en: The quality of being exceptionally clever or talented.

words.ex: Milk has a lot of calcium.
words.ex_cn: 牛奶含有大量的钙。
words.en: A chemical element that is present in teeth and bones and is necessary for their health.

words.ex: The carpenter made a wooden table.
words.ex_cn: 木匠做了一张木桌子。
words.en: A carpenter is a person whose job is making and repairing wooden objects and structures.

words.ex: The cellular structure of plants is very small.
words.ex_cn: 植物的细胞结构非常微小。
words.en: Relating to or consisting of cells; having a porous structure.

words.tr: v. 设计舞蹈动作；编舞
words.ex: She choreograph the dance for the school play.
words.ex_cn: 她为学校的戏剧设计了舞蹈动作。
words.en: To choreograph is to compose the sequence of steps and movements for a dance or a ballet.

words.tr:
n. 外衣；大衣；
v. 覆盖；
words.ex: He put on his coat before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上了外衣。
words.en: A coat is a piece of clothing with long sleeves which you wear over your other clothes when you go outside.

words.tr:
adj. 复杂的；
n. 综合楼（群）；
words.ex: The instructions are too complex for children.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明对孩子来说太复杂了。
words.en: Something that is complex has many different parts, and is therefore often difficult to understand.

words.ex: The conflict between the two countries lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家之间的冲突持续了多年。
words.en: A conflict is a serious disagreement or argument, typically a protracted one.

words.tr:
n. 内容；含量；
adj. 满足的；
words.ex: The content of the video is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这个视频的内容非常有趣。
words.en: Content refers to the things that are held or included in something, or the state of being happy and satisfied.

words.ex: The data points correlate with each other.
words.ex_cn: 这些数据点相互关联。
words.en: If one thing correlates with another, there is a close similarity or connection between them, often because one thing causes the other.

words.ex: He lived in a crude hut with no electricity.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个没有电的简陋小屋里。
words.en: A crude substance or product is in its natural state and has not been processed or refined.

words.tr:
n. 腐烂；衰落；
v. 腐烂；
words.ex: The fruit began to show signs of decay.
words.ex_cn: 这水果开始出现腐烂的迹象。
words.en: To decay means to be slowly destroyed by a natural process or to become gradually worse in quality, condition, or strength.

words.tr: v. 压下；降低；使沮丧；使不活泼；使萧条
words.ex: He depresses the button to start the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他按下按钮启动机器。
words.en: If something depresses you, it makes you feel sad and disappointed.

words.ex: He found a dime on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上找到一枚一角硬币。
words.en: A dime is a coin worth ten cents, one tenth of a United States dollar.

words.ex: The loud music distract me from my homework.
words.ex_cn: 嘈杂的音乐让我无法专心做作业。
words.en: If something distracts you or your attention, it makes you stop concentrating on what you are doing.

words.tr:
n. 水滴
v. 滴落
words.ex: The tap is dripping slowly.
words.ex_cn: 水龙头在慢慢滴水。
words.en: If a liquid drips, it falls in small drops. A drip is also a small amount of liquid that falls in this way.

words.ex: Her dress showed great elegance.
words.ex_cn: 她的裙子展现了极大的优雅。
words.en: Elegance is the quality of being graceful and stylish in appearance or manner.

words.ex: He endow a library with books.
words.ex_cn: 他捐赠了一图书馆的书。
words.en: If someone is endowed with a particular quality or ability, they naturally have it.

words.tr:
n. 等价物；
adj. 相等的；等价的；
words.ex: The dollar is the equivalent of ten yuan.
words.ex_cn: 美元是十元的等价物。
words.en: If one amount or value is the equivalent of another, they are the same.

words.tr: n. 枯竭；耗尽；筋疲力尽；
words.ex: The long hike led to his exhaustion.
words.ex_cn: 长时间的徒步旅行导致他筋疲力尽。
words.en: A state of extreme physical or mental tiredness.

words.ex: The old building has a beautiful facade with stone pillars.
words.ex_cn: 这栋老建筑有一个带有石柱的漂亮正面。
words.en: The front of a building, especially an imposing or decorative one. Also, a superficial appearance or illusion of something.

words.tr:
v. 弄懂；认为；
n. 数字；重要或有名的人物；
words.ex: I couldn't figure out why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 我弄不懂他为什么迟到。
words.en: A figure is a number, a person, a shape, or a form. It can also refer to the process of calculating or appearing in a particular way.

words.ex: She adds flour to make bread.
words.ex_cn: 她加面粉来做面包。
words.en: Flour is a powder made by grinding raw grains, roots, beans, nuts, or seeds. It is used to make many different foods.

words.tr:
n. 框架；结构；骨架；模式；
v. 表达；陷害；
words.ex: The picture is in a wooden frame.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画在一个木制框架里。
words.en: A frame is a structure that forms a border or support for something, such as a picture or a window. It can also refer to the process of making or constructing something, or the act of falsely incriminating someone.

words.tr: n. 差距；隔阂；缺口；缝隙；
words.ex: There is a big gap between rich and poor.
words.ex_cn: 富人和穷人之间有很大的差距。
words.en: A gap is a space between two things or a hole in the middle of something solid.

words.ex: The gland makes saliva in her mouth.
words.ex_cn: 这个腺体在她的嘴里产生唾液。
words.en: An organ in the body which produces and releases substances that perform a specific function in the body, such as hormones or sweat.

words.ex: The hallmark of a good teacher is patience.
words.ex_cn: 好老师的标志是耐心。
words.en: A hallmark is a distinctive characteristic or attribute that is typical of a particular person or thing.

words.ex: The broken glass is a hazard.
words.ex_cn: 碎玻璃是危险。
words.en: A hazard is something which could be dangerous to you, your health or safety, or your plans or reputation.

words.tr:
n. 原始人类
adj. 人科的
words.ex: The hominid walked on two legs.
words.ex_cn: 这种人科动物用两条腿行走。
words.en: A hominid is any primate of the family Hominidae, which includes humans and their fossil ancestors.

words.ex: The two shirts are identical.
words.ex_cn: 这两件衬衫是一样的。
words.en: Exactly the same, or very similar.

words.ex: The government will implement new rules next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将实施新规定。
words.en: To implement something means to ensure that what has been planned is done.

words.ex: The price of bread went up because of inflation.
words.ex_cn: 由于通货膨胀，面包的价格上涨了。
words.en: Inflation is a general increase in prices and fall in the purchasing value of money.

words.ex: He will install the new software on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他将在他的电脑上安装新软件。
words.en: To set up or fix in position for use or service.

words.ex: The teacher intervened when the students argued.
words.ex_cn: 当学生们争吵时，老师进行了干涉。
words.en: If you intervene in a situation, you become involved in it and try to change it.

words.ex: The hospital will isolate the patient to stop the spread.
words.ex_cn: 医院将隔离这名病人以防止传播。
words.en: To isolate someone or something means to separate them from other people or things, often in order to protect them or to prevent the spread of something harmful.

words.ex: She cooks dinner in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 她在厨房里做晚饭。
words.en: A kitchen is a room or part of a room used for cooking and food preparation in a dwelling or in a commercial establishment.

words.ex: He hired a legal lawyer to help him.
words.ex_cn: 他请了一位法律律师来帮助他。
words.en: Relating to the law or to lawyers, or permitted or required by law.

words.ex: The lithosphere moves slowly over the mantle.
words.ex_cn: 岩石圈在地幔上缓慢移动。
words.en: The lithosphere is the solid, outer part of the Earth. It includes the brittle upper portion of the mantle and the crust, the outermost layers of Earth's structure.

words.tr:
v. 吸引；诱惑；引诱
n. 诱惑；诱饵；吸引力
words.ex: The bright colors lure the birds to the feeder.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的颜色吸引鸟类来到喂食器。
words.en: If you lure someone, you tempt them to do something or to go somewhere, especially by offering some form of reward.

words.ex: The statue is made of white marble.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像由白色大理石制成。
words.en: Marble is a type of very hard rock which is used for making statues and for building. It is usually white with dark lines in it.

words.ex: He has a mental illness.
words.ex_cn: 他有心理疾病。
words.en: Relating to the mind or involving the process of thinking.

words.ex: The bug is five millimeters long.
words.ex_cn: 这只虫子五毫米长。
words.en: A unit of length equal to one thousandth of a meter.

words.ex: The monetary policy affects prices.
words.ex_cn: 货币政策影响价格。
words.en: Monetary means relating to money, especially the total amount of money in a country.

words.tr: n. 谜；难以理解的事物；
words.ex: The mystery of the missing key puzzled everyone.
words.ex_cn: 丢失的钥匙这个谜题让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: Something that is difficult or impossible to understand or explain.

words.tr: n. 商机；理想的工作或生活；
words.ex: He found a niche in selling eco-friendly phone cases.
words.ex_cn: 他在销售环保手机壳方面找到了商机。
words.en: A niche is a hollow area in a wall which has been made to hold a statue, or a comfortable or suitable position in life or employment.

words.tr:
adj. 客观的；
n. 目标；目的；
words.ex: He gave an objective opinion about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他对这部电影给出了一个客观的看法。
words.en: An objective is something that you plan to do or achieve.

words.ex: He shared his opinion about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他分享了他对这部电影的意见。
words.en: Your ideas or beliefs about a particular subject.

words.ex: The factory's output increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂上个月的产量增加了。
words.en: The amount of something produced by a person, machine, or industry.

words.tr:
adj. 平行的；
n. 类似的事物；
words.ex: The two lines are parallel and never meet.
words.ex_cn: 这两条线是平行的，永远不会相交。
words.en: Something that is parallel to something else is similar to it in many ways, or happens at the same time as it.

words.ex: The teacher learned new pedagogy from the workshop.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师从研讨会中学到了新的教学法。
words.en: The method and practice of teaching, especially as an academic subject or theoretical concept.

words.tr: n. 视角；观点；（对事物的）合理判断；
words.ex: His perspective on life is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活的看法非常积极。
words.en: A particular attitude towards or way of regarding something; a point of view.

words.tr:
n. 瘟疫；疫病；
v. 困扰；折磨；
words.ex: The plague killed many people in medieval Europe.
words.ex_cn: 瘟疫在中世纪的欧洲杀死了许多人。
words.en: A plague is a very infectious disease that spreads quickly and kills a lot of people. It can also refer to a large number of insects or animals that cause damage or are a nuisance.

words.ex: The poll showed that most people support the new law.
words.ex_cn: 这项民意调查表明，大多数人支持这项新法律。
words.en: A poll is a survey in which people are asked their opinions about something, usually in order to find out how popular something is or what people intend to do in the future.

words.tr: adj. 实用的；实际的；实践的；
words.ex: This tool is practical for everyday use.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具日常使用很实用。
words.en: relating to what is real rather than to what is possible or imagined; likely to succeed or be effective in real circumstances; involving or concerned with experience or actual use; not theoretical

words.ex: He is presumably at home now.
words.ex_cn: 推测起来，他现在在家。
words.en: If you say that something is presumably the case, you mean that you think it is very likely to be the case, although you are not certain.

words.tr: adj. 富有成效的；多产的；生产的；
words.ex: He had a productive day and finished all his work.
words.ex_cn: 他度过了富有成效的一天，完成了所有工作。
words.en: Producing or able to produce large amounts of goods, crops, or other commodities.

words.ex: He worked hard and prospered in business.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，在商业上取得了成功。
words.en: If people or businesses prosper, they are successful and do well.

words.ex: He wants to pursue his dream of becoming a writer.
words.ex_cn: 他想追求成为作家的梦想。
words.en: If you pursue an activity, interest, or plan, you carry it out or follow it.

words.ex: Last month's rainfall was very low.
words.ex_cn: 上个月的降雨量非常少。
words.en: Rainfall is the amount of rain that falls in a particular area during a particular period.

words.ex: The rebel fought against the king's rules.
words.ex_cn: 这位叛逆者反抗国王的法令。
words.en: A rebel is a person who opposes or fights against people in authority.

words.ex: He refines his writing every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天完善自己的写作。
words.en: To refine something means to make it purer or to improve it, especially by removing unwanted substances or by making small changes.

words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.ex: The job is repetitive and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作重复且无聊。
words.en: Something that is repetitive involves doing the same thing over and over again.

words.tr:
n. 方面；尊重；尊敬；
v. 遵从；尊重；尊敬；
words.ex: In this respect, the plan is good.
words.ex_cn: 在这个方面，这个计划很好。
words.en: If you respect someone, you have a good opinion of their character or ideas.

words.ex: The rhythm of the music made everyone dance.
words.ex_cn: 音乐的节奏让所有人都跳起了舞。
words.en: A rhythm is a regular series of sounds or movements.

words.tr: n. 死记硬背；机械的做法；生搬硬套
words.ex: He learned the poem by rote.
words.ex_cn: 他通过死记硬背学会了这首诗。
words.en: Rote is the process of learning something by repeating it many times without thinking about it or understanding it.

words.ex: The satellite sends pictures from space.
words.ex_cn: 卫星从太空发送图片。
words.en: A satellite is an object which has been sent into space in order to collect information or to be part of a communications system. Satellites move continually round the earth or around another planet.

words.ex: The sculptor carved a statue from stone.
words.ex_cn: 这位雕刻家从石头中雕刻出一座雕像。
words.en: A sculptor is an artist who creates sculptures.

words.tr: adj. 感伤的；感情的；多愁善感的
words.ex: He kept the old toy because he was sentimental about it.
words.ex_cn: 他保留了那个旧玩具，因为他对它有感情。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as sentimental, you mean that they are influenced by emotional feelings, especially about happy memories of past events or relationships with other people, rather than by careful thought and judgment based on facts.

words.tr:
n. 转移；移位；转变；轮班；
v. 变换位置；转移；换（挡）；轮班；
words.ex: The shift of power to the new government was sudden.
words.ex_cn: 权力向新政府的转移是突然的。
words.en: If you shift something or if it shifts, it moves or changes its position slightly. If someone's opinion, attitude, or behaviour shifts, it changes slightly, especially in response to a particular situation or event.

words.tr:
n. 洗涤槽；水槽；
v. （使）沉没；
words.ex: The dirty dishes are in the sink.
words.ex_cn: 脏盘子在水槽里。
words.en: If a boat sinks, or if something sinks it, it disappears below the surface of a mass of water.

words.tr: adj. 剧增的；高耸云霄的； v. “soar”的现在分词；
words.ex: The soaring prices made people angry.
words.ex_cn: 剧增的价格让人们感到愤怒。
words.en: If something such as a bird soars into the air, it goes quickly and smoothly upwards.

words.ex: This forest has many different species of birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有多种不同的鸟类物种。
words.en: A species is a class of plants or animals whose members have the same main characteristics and are able to breed with each other.

words.ex: The city's sprawl has covered many farmlands.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的杂乱无序的拓展覆盖了许多农田。
words.en: If you sprawl somewhere, you sit or lie with your legs and arms spread out in a careless way.

words.tr: adj. 庄重的；庄严的；堂皇的；
words.ex: The stately mansion stood on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 那座庄重的豪宅矗立在山上。
words.en: Something that is stately is impressive because of its size, beauty, or grandeur.

words.tr:
n. 库存；股票；家畜；
v. 备有；贮存；
words.ex: The store has low stock of winter coats.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的冬衣库存很少。
words.en: The supply of goods available for sale in a store; the capital raised by a company through the issue of shares.

words.tr:
v. 闲逛；散步；漫步；
n. 闲逛；散步；漫步；
words.ex: They stroll in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们晚饭后在公园里闲逛。
words.en: If you stroll somewhere, you walk there in a slow, relaxed way.

words.ex: He worked hard and succeeded in the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，考试成功了。
words.en: To achieve something that you have been aiming for, or to take over a position or role after someone else.

words.ex: There was a surge in sales during the holiday season.
words.ex_cn: 假期期间销量激增。
words.en: If something surges, it increases suddenly and greatly, after having been steady or only small in size or amount.

words.ex: I feel sympathy for the poor children.
words.ex_cn: 我对那些可怜的孩子感到同情。
words.en: If you have sympathy for someone who is in a bad situation, you are sorry for them, and show this in the way you behave towards them.

words.tr:
n. 税；税款；
v. 对...征税；
words.ex: He pays tax every year.
words.ex_cn: 他每年缴税。
words.en: A tax is a sum of money that you have to pay to the government so that it can pay for public services.

words.ex: The hikers struggled across the rough terrain.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者艰难地穿越了崎岖的地形。
words.en: Terrain is used to refer to an area of land or a type of land when you are considering its physical features.

words.ex: He threshed the wheat by hand last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周用手打谷。
words.en: To separate the grain from the plant by beating.

words.ex: She added a tomato to her salad.
words.ex_cn: 她往沙拉里加了一个西红柿。
words.en: A tomato is a soft, red fruit that is eaten raw or cooked as a vegetable.

words.ex: The bank recorded the transaction quickly.
words.ex_cn: 银行迅速记录了这笔交易。
words.en: A transaction is an instance of buying or selling something; a business deal.

words.tr:
v. 触发；引起；发动；
n. 诱因；触发；
words.ex: The loud noise triggered the alarm.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音触发了警报。
words.en: A trigger is a device that activates a mechanism when it is pulled or pressed. It can also refer to something that causes a particular reaction or development.

words.ex: A bird built a nest on a small twig.
words.ex_cn: 一只鸟在一根小嫩枝上筑了巢。
words.en: A twig is a very small thin branch that grows out from a main branch of a tree or bush.

words.ex: It is unlikely to rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天不大可能下雨。
words.en: If you say that something is unlikely to happen or unlikely to be true, you mean that you think it will not happen or that it is not true, although it is not certain.

words.tr: adj. 各种各样的；不同的；各种的；
words.ex: He bought various fruits at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了各种各样的水果。
words.en: If you say that there are various things, you mean there are several different things of the type mentioned.

words.tr: adj. 精力充沛的；茂盛的；
words.ex: He is a vigorous man who runs every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个精力充沛的人，每天早上都跑步。
words.en: A vigorous person does things with great energy and enthusiasm. A vigorous campaign or activity is done with great energy and enthusiasm.

words.tr:
v. 衰落；减弱；缺；亏
n. 衰退；减弱；缺；亏
words.ex: The moon begins to wane after the full moon.
words.ex_cn: 满月之后，月亮开始变暗。
words.en: If something wanes, it becomes gradually weaker or less, often so that it eventually disappears.

words.tr:
adj. 批发的；
n. 成批出售；
adv. 大批地；
words.ex: He buys clothes at wholesale prices.
words.ex_cn: 他以批发价购买衣服。
words.en: Wholesale is the business of buying and selling goods in large quantities, especially for resale to retailers.

words.ex: The youngster rode his bike to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个年轻人每天骑自行车去上学。
words.en: A youngster is a young person, especially a child or teenager.

words.tr: n. 事故；意外事件；意外；
words.ex: He was hurt in a car accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在一场车祸中受伤了。
words.en: An accident is an unexpected and undesirable event, especially one resulting in damage or harm.

words.ex: I admire my teacher for her patience.
words.ex_cn: 我钦佩我的老师有耐心。
words.en: If you admire someone or something, you like and respect them very much.

words.tr:
n. 合金
v. 把…铸成合金
words.ex: He made a strong alloy from copper and zinc.
words.ex_cn: 他用铜和锌制造了一种坚固的合金。
words.en: An alloy is a metal made by combining two or more metallic elements, especially to give greater strength or resistance to corrosion.

words.ex: I anticipate rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我预料明天会下雨。
words.en: If you anticipate an event, you realize in advance that it may happen and you are prepared for it.

words.ex: He wrote an article about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的文章。
words.en: An article is a piece of writing on a particular subject in a newspaper, magazine, or online. It can also refer to a particular item or object, or a clause in a legal document.

words.ex: The farmer uses an auger to drill holes in the ground.
words.ex_cn: 农夫使用螺旋钻在地里钻孔。
words.en: An auger is a tool consisting of a rotating helical shaft used to move material or drill holes.

words.ex: The tree has bare branches in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在冬天有光秃秃的树枝。
words.en: If part of your body is bare, it is not covered by any clothing.

words.ex: This book belongs to me.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于我。
words.en: If something belongs to you, you own it or it is yours.

words.ex: He felt a bodily pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到身体疼痛。
words.en: Relating to the human body.

words.tr:
n. 边；边缘；帽边
v. （装）满；（使）溢出
words.ex: The cup is full to the brim.
words.ex_cn: 杯子装得满满的。
words.en: The top edge of a container or the projecting edge of a hat.

words.ex: He checks the calendar every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都看日历。
words.en: A calendar is a chart or device which displays the date and the day of the week, and often the whole of a particular year divided up into months, weeks, and days.

words.ex: The king rode in a wooden carriage drawn by four horses.
words.ex_cn: 国王乘坐一辆由四匹马拉的木制四轮马车。
words.en: A carriage is a vehicle with four wheels that is pulled by horses and is used for carrying people.

words.tr: n. 植物纤维质；纤维素；
words.ex: Trees contain a lot of cellulose in their walls.
words.ex_cn: 树木的细胞壁中含有大量的植物纤维质。
words.en: Cellulose is a substance that exists in the cell walls of plants and is used to make paper, textiles, and explosives.

words.tr:
v. 合唱；异口同声地说
n. 合唱团；合唱
words.ex: They chorus when the song reaches the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 当歌曲进行到桥段时，他们一起合唱。
words.en: A chorus is a part of a song which is repeated after each verse, or a group of people who sing together.

words.ex: The team showed cohesive behavior during the project.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队在项目期间表现出有凝聚力的行为。
words.en: If something is cohesive, it consists of parts that fit together well and form a united whole.

words.ex: The math problem is complicated.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学问题很复杂。
words.en: Involving many different and confusing aspects.

words.ex: He conform to the rules of the school.
words.ex_cn: 他遵守学校的规章制度。
words.en: To conform means to behave in a way that is accepted by most people or to obey a rule, law, or custom.

words.ex: The word means different things in different context.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在不同的上下文中意思不同。
words.en: The context of an idea or event is the general situation that relates to it, and which helps it to be understood.

words.ex: The number of apples corresponds to the number of oranges.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的数量与橙子的数量相对应。
words.en: If one thing corresponds to another, there is a close similarity or connection between them, often because one is the cause or the result of the other.

words.ex: The earth's crust is made of rock.
words.ex_cn: 地球的地壳由岩石组成。
words.en: The crust is the hard outer layer of something, such as bread or the Earth's surface.

words.ex: He deceived his friend with a lie.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个谎言欺骗了朋友。
words.en: If you deceive someone, you make them believe something that is not true, usually in order to get some advantage for yourself.

words.ex: The storm deprived us of electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴剥夺了我们的电力。
words.en: If you deprive someone of something that they want or need, you take it away from them, or you prevent them from having it.

words.ex: The dimension of the box is 10 cm by 5 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的尺寸是10厘米乘5厘米。
words.en: A dimension is a measurement of something in a particular direction, or the scope or scale of something.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.ex: A droplet fell from the leaf.
words.ex_cn: 一滴水从叶子上落下。
words.en: A droplet is a very small drop of a liquid.

words.ex: Exercise can elevate your mood.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以提升你的情绪。
words.en: To elevate something means to raise it to a higher position or level, either physically or in terms of its status or importance.

words.ex: He had to endure the cold winter without a coat.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不在没有外套的情况下忍受寒冷的冬天。
words.en: To endure means to suffer something difficult, unpleasant, or painful, or to continue to exist for a long time.

words.ex: The invention of the internet changed our era.
words.ex_cn: 互联网的发明改变了我们的时代。
words.en: An era is a period of time that is considered as a single unit because of a particular characteristic or event.

words.ex: The museum will exhibit ancient coins next month.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆下个月将展览古钱币。
words.en: To exhibit something means to show it in a public place so that people can go to see it. It can also mean to show a particular quality, ability, or type of behavior.

words.ex: The weather report said it's 90 degrees Fahrenheit today.
words.ex_cn: 天气预报说今天是90华氏度。
words.en: Of or relating to a temperature scale that registers the freezing point of water as 32° and the boiling point as 212° at one atmosphere of pressure.

words.tr:
v. 过滤；
n. 过滤器；
words.ex: She filters the water before drinking it.
words.ex_cn: 她在喝水之前过滤水。
words.en: A filter is a device or a method that removes unwanted substances from something such as water, air, or light, by passing it through a special material or system.

words.tr: v. 繁荣兴旺；茁壮成长；
words.ex: The business flourishes in the new market.
words.ex_cn: 这家企业在新市场中繁荣兴旺。
words.en: If something flourishes, it is successful, active, or common, and developing quickly and strongly.

words.ex: The freight train carried boxes to the city.
words.ex_cn: 货运列车把箱子运到了城市。
words.en: Freight refers to goods transported in bulk by truck, train, ship, or aircraft. It can also mean the charge for such transportation.

words.ex: The children threw garbage on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们把垃圾扔在地上。
words.en: Waste material; unwanted or undesired material.

words.ex: The glare of the sun made it hard to see.
words.ex_cn: 阳光的刺眼使我看不清。
words.en: If you glare at someone, you look at them with an angry expression on your face. Glare is also a very bright light that is uncomfortable to look at.

words.ex: The children ran down the hallway.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在走廊里奔跑。
words.en: A hallway is a long passage inside a building with doors leading off to rooms on either side.

words.ex: The wound will heal in a few days.
words.ex_cn: 伤口几天后就会愈合。
words.en: To make or become healthy or whole again; to cure or recover from an injury or illness.

words.ex: The mixture is homogeneous and looks the same throughout.
words.ex_cn: 这种混合物是均一的，看起来处处都一样。
words.en: Something that is homogeneous is uniform in nature or character throughout.

words.ex: He can identify the bird by its song.
words.ex_cn: 他能通过鸟的叫声识别它。
words.en: If you can identify someone or something, you are able to recognize them or distinguish them from others.

words.ex: His silence was an implicit apology.
words.ex_cn: 他的沉默是一种含蓄的道歉。
words.en: Something that is implicit is expressed in an indirect way.

words.ex: There was a large influx of tourists during the summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天期间涌入了大量游客。
words.en: An influx of people or things is a large number of them arriving somewhere at the same time.

words.tr:
adj. 立即的；即时的；
n. 瞬间；立即；
words.ex: He wants an instant answer.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一个立即的回答。
words.en: An instant is a very short period of time, or a particular point in time.

words.ex: The intestine helps digest food.
words.ex_cn: 肠道帮助消化食物。
words.en: The part of the alimentary canal between the stomach and the anus.

words.tr:
n. 问题；重要议题；发行（物）；
v. 发行；
words.ex: The main issue is lack of money.
words.ex_cn: 主要问题是缺乏资金。
words.en: An issue is an important subject or problem that people are talking about or arguing about.

words.tr:
n. 标签；
v. 用标签标明；
words.ex: The bottle has a label with the name of the drink.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子上有一个写着饮料名称的标签。
words.en: A label is a piece of paper, polymer, cloth, metal, or other material affixed to a container or article, on which is written or printed information or symbols about the product or item.

words.ex: The legend says a dragon lives in the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 传说有一条龙住在山里。
words.en: A legend is a very old and popular story that may be true or may be imaginary.

words.ex: The children left litter on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在海滩上留下了垃圾。
words.en: If a place is littered with something, it contains many examples of it that are usually not arranged neatly or properly.

words.tr:
n. 强烈的性欲；强烈的欲望
v. 对…有极强的性欲（或欲望）
words.ex: His lust for power ruined his relationships.
words.ex_cn: 他对权力的强烈欲望毁掉了他的关系。
words.en: Lust is a strong feeling of wanting to have or to do something, especially sexual desire.

words.tr: n. 差额；边缘；净利润；余地；
words.ex: The profit margin is five dollars.
words.ex_cn: 利润差额是五美元。
words.en: The margin is the edge or border of something, or the difference between two amounts, especially the difference between the cost of producing something and the price it is sold for.

words.tr:
v. 提到；说到；
n. 提及；说起；
words.ex: He didn't mention the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他没有提到那场事故。
words.en: If you mention something, you say something about it, usually briefly.

words.ex: The child mimics her mother's voice.
words.ex_cn: 孩子模仿她妈妈的声音。
words.en: If someone or something mimics another person or thing, they try to be like them or copy their behavior or characteristics.

words.tr:
adj. 单色的；黑白的
n. 单色画；黑白照片
words.ex: The painting is monochrome, only black and white.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是单色的，只有黑色和白色。
words.en: Using only black, white, and shades of grey, or using only one colour.

words.ex: It's a myth that eating late at night causes weight gain.
words.ex_cn: 晚上吃东西会导致发胖，这是一种错误观念。
words.en: A myth is a traditional story, especially one concerning the early history of a people or explaining some natural or social phenomenon, and typically involving supernatural beings or events.

words.ex: The coin is made of nickel.
words.ex_cn: 这枚硬币是镍制的。
words.en: A hard silver-white metal that is used in making alloys and is a chemical element. It is also a coin worth five cents in the US and Canada.

words.ex: The law obliges drivers to wear seat belts.
words.ex_cn: 法律迫使司机系安全带。
words.en: If you are obliged to do something, you have to do it because the situation, the law, a duty, etc., makes it necessary.

words.ex: He got an opportunity to work abroad.
words.ex_cn: 他得到了一个去国外工作的机会。
words.en: An opportunity is a situation in which it is possible for you to do something that you want to do.

words.tr: adj. 杰出的；尚未处理的；
words.ex: He is an outstanding student who always gets top grades.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名杰出的学生，总是取得最高分。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as outstanding, you think that they are very remarkable and impressive.

words.tr: adj. 最高的；至上的；最重要的；
words.ex: His safety is paramount.
words.ex_cn: 他的安全是最重要的。
words.en: Something that is paramount or of paramount importance is more important than anything else.

words.tr:
n. 同辈；同等的人；
v. 凝视；
words.ex: He feels comfortable talking to his peers.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得和同辈交谈很自在。
words.en: A peer is someone who is equal to another in abilities, qualifications, age, background, or social status. As a verb, to peer means to look keenly or with difficulty at someone or something.

words.ex: The smell of flowers was pervasive in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 花的香味遍布整个花园。
words.en: Something that is pervasive is present or noticeable throughout a place or thing.

words.tr:
n. 平原；
adj. 简单明了的；朴素的；
words.ex: The cows graze on the plain.
words.ex_cn: 牛在平原上吃草。
words.en: If something is plain, it is easy to see, hear, or understand.

words.ex: Bees collect pollen from flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂从花朵中采集花粉。
words.en: Pollen is a fine powder produced by flowers, which is carried by the wind or insects to other flowers of the same species, causing them to produce seeds.

words.tr: n. 实践者；从业者；执业者；
words.ex: He is a medical practitioner who helps patients every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位每天帮助病人的医疗实践者。
words.en: A practitioner is someone who works in a particular profession, especially one that requires special training and skills.

words.tr: n. 自命不凡；自称；标榜；虚荣
words.ex: His pretension made others think he was better than them.
words.ex_cn: 他的自命不凡让别人觉得他比他们强。
words.en: If you say that someone has pretensions, you mean that they claim or pretend that they are more important, intelligent, or skilled than they really are.

words.ex: His profession is a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他的职业是教师。
words.en: A profession is a type of job that requires advanced education or training.

words.ex: He is the protagonist in the story.
words.ex_cn: 他是故事中的主角。
words.en: The main character in a story, play, film, etc., especially the one who is good or who the audience is expected to support.

words.ex: He solved the crossword puzzle quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解开了这个填字谜。
words.en: If something puzzles you, you do not understand it and feel confused.

words.tr:
v. 集合起来；振作；复苏
n. 集会
words.ex: The crowd rallied to support their team.
words.ex_cn: 人群聚集起来支持他们的球队。
words.en: A rally is a large public meeting that is held in order to show support for something such as a political party or a sports team. It can also mean to come together again in order to continue fighting or arguing after a defeat or a period of confusion.

words.ex: They will rebuild the house after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他们将在风暴后重建这座房子。
words.en: To rebuild something means to build it again after it has been damaged or destroyed.

words.tr: n. 沉思；反射；反映；反省；
words.ex: He sat quietly in the garden for reflection.
words.ex_cn: 他静静地坐在花园里沉思。
words.en: A reflection is an image that you can see in a mirror, glass, or water.

words.tr: n. 减缓；宽慰；解脱；救济；
words.ex: The medicine brought relief to his pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药缓解了他的疼痛。
words.en: Relief is a feeling of reassurance and relaxation following release from anxiety or distress.

words.ex: She replenished the water bottle after the hike.
words.ex_cn: 她在徒步后补充了水瓶里的水。
words.en: If you replenish something, you make it full or complete again.

words.ex: He responded to the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回答了问题。
words.en: If you respond to something that is done or said, you react to it by doing or saying something yourself.

words.ex: She tied a red ribbon around the box.
words.ex_cn: 她把一条红色的带状物系在盒子上。
words.en: A ribbon is a long, narrow piece of cloth that you use for tying things together or as a decoration.

words.ex: The wood surface is rough.
words.ex_cn: 木头表面很粗糙。
words.en: If a surface is rough, it is not smooth and has bumps or uneven areas.

words.ex: The movie is a satire about politicians.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是一部关于政治家的讽刺作品。
words.en: A way of criticizing people or ideas in a humorous way, especially in order to make a political point, or a piece of writing that uses this style.

words.tr:
v. 小步疾走；急赶
n. 快跑声；疾走
words.ex: The mouse scurried under the table.
words.ex_cn: 老鼠迅速跑到了桌子底下。
words.en: If people or small animals scurry somewhere, they move there quickly and hurriedly, especially because they are frightened.

words.ex: The children cleaned their rooms separately.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们分别打扫了自己的房间。
words.en: If people or things are dealt with separately, they are dealt with individually, not in a group.

words.ex: The sun shines brightly in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在早晨明亮地发光。
words.en: To emit or reflect light brightly; to be very good at something.

words.ex: The skeleton of the dinosaur is displayed in the museum.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙的骨架在博物馆里展出。
words.en: The internal structure that supports and gives shape to a person, animal, or plant, composed of bones and cartilage in vertebrates.

words.ex: He adds sodium to his food for taste.
words.ex_cn: 他为了味道在食物里加钠。
words.en: Sodium is a soft, silvery-white, highly reactive metal. Sodium is an alkali metal, being in group 1 of the periodic table, because it has a single electron in its outer shell that it readily donates, creating a positively charged ion—the Na⁺ cation.

words.ex: Please specify the time for the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 请详细说明会议的时间。
words.en: If you specify something, you give information about what is required or should happen in a certain situation.

words.ex: This project is a springboard for his future career.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目是他未来职业的出发点。
words.en: A springboard is a flexible board from which someone may jump into water or onto a mat in gymnastics. It can also refer to something that provides an opportunity to achieve something.

words.ex: The chair is stationary and does not move.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子是固定的，不会移动。
words.en: not moving or not intended to be moved

words.ex: He ate too much and his stomach hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多了，胃疼。
words.en: The stomach is the organ in your body where food is digested after you have eaten it.

words.ex: The bridge has a strong structural design.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥有坚固的结构设计。
words.en: Relating to the arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.

words.ex: He gave a succinct answer.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了一个简洁的回答。
words.en: Something that is succinct expresses facts or ideas clearly and in few words.

words.ex: The surgeon fixed the broken bone.
words.ex_cn: 外科医生修复了断裂的骨头。
words.en: A surgeon is a medical doctor who performs operations.

words.ex: He listened to a beautiful symphony last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚听了一首美妙的交响乐。
words.en: A symphony is a long piece of music that is usually in four parts and is performed by an orchestra.

words.ex: Our team won the soccer match.
words.ex_cn: 我们的团队赢得了足球比赛。
words.en: A team is a group of people who play a particular sport or game together against other similar groups of people.

words.ex: The terrestrial animals live on land.
words.ex_cn: 陆地动物生活在陆地上。
words.en: Of, on, or relating to the earth.

words.tr: v. 兴旺；繁荣；茁壮成长；
words.ex: Plants thrive in sunny places.
words.ex_cn: 植物在阳光充足的地方茁壮成长。
words.en: To thrive means to grow or develop well or vigorously.

words.ex: He speaks Chinese as his mother tongue.
words.ex_cn: 他把汉语作为母语。
words.en: The tongue is the flexible muscular organ in the mouth that is used for tasting, licking, swallowing, and (in humans) articulating speech.

words.ex: She transcended her fears to speak on stage.
words.ex_cn: 她超越了自己的恐惧，在舞台上发言。
words.en: If something transcends normal limits or boundaries, it goes beyond them, because it is more significant than them.

words.ex: The country has a debt of one trillion dollars.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家有一万亿美元的债务。
words.en: A trillion is a number equal to 10^12 in the American system or 10^18 in the British system.

words.tr:
n. 合股绳；捻线；麻绳
v. 缠绕；盘绕；使缠结
words.ex: He tied the box with twine.
words.ex_cn: 他用麻绳绑住了盒子。
words.en: Twine refers to a strong thread or string consisting of two or more strands twisted together. It can also mean to twist or wind something around something else.

words.ex: The storm caused unprecedented damage.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴造成了前所未有的破坏。
words.en: If something is unprecedented, it has never happened before.

words.tr:
n. 清漆；漆面；光泽面
v. 给…涂上清漆
words.ex: He put varnish on the wooden table.
words.ex_cn: 他在木桌上涂了清漆。
words.en: Varnish is a transparent, hard, protective finish or film primarily used in wood finishing but also for other materials. Varnish is traditionally a combination of a drying oil, a resin, and a thinner or solvent.

words.ex: He put vinegar on his salad.
words.ex_cn: 他把醋倒在沙拉上。
words.en: A sour-tasting liquid used as a condiment or preservative, typically made by fermenting dilute alcoholic liquids such as wine, cider, or beer.

words.tr:
n. 病房；病室；选区；
v. 监护；守护；挡住；
words.ex: The patient is in ward 5.
words.ex_cn: 病人在5号病房。
words.en: A ward is a separate room in a hospital, typically one allocated to a particular type of patient, or a person, especially a child, who is under the protection or care of a legal guardian or a court.

words.tr: adj. 流传甚广的；分布广的；
words.ex: The flu became widespread last winter.
words.ex_cn: 去年冬天流感流传甚广。
words.en: Something that is widespread exists or happens over a large area, or to a great extent.

words.tr:
n. 之字形；锯齿形；
adj. 之字形的；曲折的；锯齿形的；
words.ex: The road makes a zigzag up the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这条路沿着山呈之字形向上延伸。
words.en: A zigzag is a line that has a series of angles in it, like a continuous series of 'W's. It can also describe a path or route that proceeds by sharp turns in alternating directions.

words.ex: The actor received acclaim for his performance.
words.ex_cn: 这位演员因他的表演而受到赞扬。
words.en: If someone or something is acclaimed, they are praised enthusiastically and publicly.

words.ex: The ticket is your admission to the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这张票是进入音乐会的许可。
words.en: An admission is a statement in which you admit that something bad, unpleasant, or embarrassing is true, or the act of allowing someone to enter a place or organization.

words.tr: v. 暗指；（间接）提到；影射
words.ex: He alluded to the problem without naming it.
words.ex_cn: 他暗示了这个问题，但没有点明。
words.en: To allude to something means to mention it in an indirect way.

words.ex: The old law was antiquated by the new government.
words.ex_cn: 旧法律被新政府废除了。
words.en: To make something old-fashioned or obsolete.

words.ex: He can articulate his ideas clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他能清楚地表达自己的想法。
words.en: If you describe someone as articulate, you mean that they are able to express their thoughts and ideas easily and clearly.

words.tr: adj. 真正的；真实的；真迹的；可靠的；
words.ex: This is an authentic painting by Picasso.
words.ex_cn: 这是一幅毕加索的真迹。
words.en: If something is authentic, it is real, true, or what people say it is.

words.ex: The barge carried coal down the river.
words.ex_cn: 驳船沿河运送煤炭。
words.en: A barge is a long, flat-bottomed boat used for carrying freight on canals and rivers.

words.ex: The factory uses a belt to move boxes.
words.ex_cn: 工厂使用传送带来运送箱子。
words.en: A belt is a strip of leather or other material worn around the waist to support clothes or for decoration.

words.ex: The water begins to boil at 100 degrees.
words.ex_cn: 水在100度时开始沸腾。
words.en: When a liquid boils or when you boil it, it reaches the temperature at which it starts to turn into a gas.

words.ex: The glass is brittle and breaks easily.
words.ex_cn: 这种玻璃很硬但容易碎。
words.en: If something is brittle, it is hard and easily broken.

words.ex: Bread and rice are rich in carbohydrate.
words.ex_cn: 面包和米饭富含碳水化合物。
words.en: A carbohydrate is a substance found in foods such as bread, potatoes, and rice which provides your body with heat and energy and which consists of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen.

words.ex: The farmer drove his cart full of apples to the market.
words.ex_cn: 农夫驾着装满苹果的运货马车去市场。
words.en: A cart is a vehicle with two or four wheels that is pulled by a horse or a person and is used for carrying goods.

words.ex: The water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
words.ex_cn: 水在100摄氏度时沸腾。
words.en: Celsius is a scale for measuring temperature, in which water freezes at 0 degrees and boils at 100 degrees.

words.ex: He ate a chunk of cheese for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一大块奶酪。
words.en: A chunk of something is a large piece or amount of it.

words.ex: She picked up the coil of rope from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 她从地上捡起了那卷绳子。
words.en: A coil is a length of something wound in a joined sequence of loops, or the act of winding something into loops.

words.ex: A car has many components, like wheels and engines.
words.ex_cn: 汽车有许多部分，比如轮子和发动机。
words.en: A component is a part of a larger whole, especially a part that can be separated from or attached to a system.

words.ex: He must confront his fears.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的恐惧。
words.en: If you confront a difficult situation or issue, you accept the fact that it exists and try to deal with it.

words.ex: The continual rain made the road very muddy.
words.ex_cn: 不停的雨让道路变得非常泥泞。
words.en: Something that is continual happens repeatedly over a period of time.

words.ex: The boy walked down the long corridor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩走过了长长的走廊。
words.en: A corridor is a long passage in a building, with doors and rooms on one or both sides.

words.ex: She wears a necklace made of crystal.
words.ex_cn: 她戴一条水晶制成的项链。
words.en: A crystal is a solid that has a regular, repeating arrangement of atoms. Crystals are often transparent and can be used in jewelry or as decorative objects.

words.ex: The president will declare a holiday next week.
words.ex_cn: 总统将在下周宣布放假。
words.en: If you declare something, you state it formally, publicly, or officially.

words.ex: We derive the answer from the formula.
words.ex_cn: 我们从公式中得到答案。
words.en: If you derive something such as pleasure or benefit from a person or from something, you get it from them.

words.ex: The child loves to watch dinosaurs on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子喜欢在电视上看恐龙。
words.en: A dinosaur is a type of reptile that lived millions of years ago, known for its large size and often extinct species.

words.ex: This district has many parks and schools.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有许多公园和学校。
words.en: A district is a part of a city, country, or other area that has been officially designated for a particular purpose, such as administration or business.

words.ex: The drought made it hard to grow crops.
words.ex_cn: 旱灾使种植庄稼变得困难。
words.en: A drought is a long period of time during which no rain falls and hence there is a shortage of water.

words.ex: The teacher asked a simple question to elicit answers from students.
words.ex_cn: 老师问了一个简单的问题来引出学生的回答。
words.en: To elicit a response or a reaction means to cause it to happen by something that you say or do.

words.tr: adj. 有活力的；精力旺盛的；
words.ex: The energetic boy ran around the park all afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个有活力的男孩整个下午都在公园里跑来跑去。
words.en: Someone who is energetic is very active and does not tire easily.

words.ex: They erect a flagpole in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们在公园里竖立一根旗杆。
words.en: If people erect something such as a building, bridge, or barrier, they build it or create it.

words.tr: adj. 令人兴奋的； v. “exhilarate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The roller coaster ride was exhilarating.
words.ex_cn: 过山车之旅令人兴奋。
words.en: If you describe something as exhilarating, you mean that it makes you feel very happy and excited.

words.ex: The faint light from the candle barely lit the room.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛微弱的光几乎照不亮房间。
words.en: If you feel faint, you feel weak and as if you are about to lose consciousness. Something that is faint is not strong or clear.

words.tr:
adj. 很好的；晴朗的；健康的；
n. 罚款；
words.ex: She did a fine job on the project.
words.ex_cn: 她在这个项目上做得很好。
words.en: If you say that something is fine, you mean that it is satisfactory or acceptable.

words.ex: The price of oil fluctuates every day.
words.ex_cn: 油价每天都在波动。
words.en: To fluctuate means to change or vary frequently and unpredictably.

words.ex: He makes frequent trips to the city.
words.ex_cn: 他经常去城市。
words.en: If something is frequent, it happens often.

words.ex: He shifted the gear to slow down the car.
words.ex_cn: 他换挡以减慢车速。
words.en: Gear refers to a toothed wheel that works with others to alter the relation between the speed of a driving mechanism (such as the engine of a vehicle) and the speed of the driven parts (the wheels). It can also mean equipment that is used for a particular purpose.

words.tr: adj. 像玻璃的；光滑的；呆滞的
words.ex: The lake surface looked glassy in the morning light.
words.ex_cn: 清晨的阳光下，湖面像玻璃一样平静。
words.en: Resembling glass, as in smoothness, transparency, or brittleness.

words.tr:
v. 中断；暂停；
n. 停顿下来；
words.ex: The storm halted the flight.
words.ex_cn: 风暴中断了航班。
words.en: to bring or come to a stop; a temporary or permanent stop

words.tr:
v. 注意；留心
n. 注意；留心
words.ex: He did not heed the warning.
words.ex_cn: 他没有理会那个警告。
words.en: If you heed someone's advice or warning, you pay attention to it and do what they suggest.

words.tr:
n. 荣誉；荣幸；尊敬；
v. 尊敬；给予荣誉；履行；
words.ex: He received an honor for his brave actions.
words.ex_cn: 他因勇敢的行为获得了荣誉。
words.en: Honor is a quality that combines respect, pride, and honesty. A person who has honor is someone who is admired and respected because of his or her integrity and ethical behavior.

words.tr: n. 意识形态；思想体系；
words.ex: His ideology is based on equality and justice.
words.ex_cn: 他的意识形态基于平等与正义。
words.en: An ideology is a set of beliefs, especially one held by a particular group, that influences the way people think and behave.

words.ex: His silence implies he disagrees.
words.ex_cn: 他的沉默暗示他不同意。
words.en: To suggest or indicate something indirectly rather than stating it explicitly.

words.tr: adj. 有独创性的；巧妙的；
words.ex: The child came up with an ingenious way to solve the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子想出了一个有独创性的方式来解决这个谜题。
words.en: Something that is ingenious is very clever and involves new ideas, methods, or equipment.

words.ex: Birds fly south by instinct.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类凭本能飞向南方。
words.en: An instinct is the natural tendency that a person or animal has to behave or react in a particular way.

words.ex: They have an intimate friendship.
words.ex_cn: 他们有着亲密的友谊。
words.en: having a close, friendly, or personal relationship with someone; private and personal

words.ex: She stored jam in a glass jar.
words.ex_cn: 她把果酱存放在一个玻璃罐里。
words.en: A jar is a glass or clay container with a wide opening at the top and a lid, used especially for storing food.

words.ex: He works in a laboratory on Fridays.
words.ex_cn: 他在星期五去实验室工作。
words.en: A laboratory is a place equipped for scientific research, experiments, or teaching.

words.ex: The new legislation bans plastic bags.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法规禁止使用塑料袋。
words.en: Legislation refers to the process of making or enacting laws by a government or other authority.

words.ex: Farming is his main livelihood.
words.ex_cn: 务农是他的主要生计。
words.en: A person's livelihood is the way they earn money in order to live.

words.tr: n. 奢华；奢侈品；难得的享受；
words.ex: She bought a luxury dress for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一件奢华的裙子。
words.en: Luxury is very great comfort, especially among beautiful and expensive surroundings.

words.ex: The small town has a maritime history.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇有着海洋历史。
words.en: Relating to the sea, especially in relation to seaborne trade or naval matters.

words.ex: The merchant sells fresh fruit every morning.
words.ex_cn: 商人每天早上卖新鲜水果。
words.en: A merchant is a person who buys and sells goods, especially one who owns a shop.

words.ex: Rock contains many minerals.
words.ex_cn: 岩石中含有许多矿物。
words.en: A mineral is a solid substance that occurs naturally and has a specific chemical composition and structure.

words.tr: adj. 单调乏味的；毫无变化的；
words.ex: The work is monotonous and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作单调乏味。
words.en: Something that is monotonous is very boring because it has a regular, repeated pattern which never changes.

words.ex: He hammered the nail into the wood.
words.ex_cn: 他把钉子敲进了木头里。
words.en: A nail is a thin pointed piece of metal that is hammered into materials as a fastener. It can also refer to the hard covering at the end of fingers and toes. As a verb, to nail means to fasten something with a nail or to catch or accomplish something successfully.

words.ex: His nickname is 'Speedy' because he runs fast.
words.ex_cn: 他的绰号是‘飞毛腿’，因为他跑得快。
words.en: A nickname is an informal name for someone or something, especially a name that you are called by your friends or family, usually based on your real name or your character.

words.ex: The meaning of the poem is obscure.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗的意思不清楚。
words.en: If something is obscure, it is not well known or not easily understood.

words.ex: He opposes the new law.
words.ex_cn: 他反对这项新法律。
words.en: If you oppose someone or something, you disagree with them and try to prevent them from doing something, or you try to change what they are doing.

words.ex: The outward force pushed the door open.
words.ex_cn: 向外的力把门推开了。
words.en: An outward movement or position is one that is directed towards the outside or away from the centre.

words.ex: He paraphrased the poem in simple words.
words.ex_cn: 他用简单的语言意译了这首诗。
words.en: To paraphrase means to express the meaning of something written or spoken using different words, especially to achieve greater clarity.

words.ex: He got a penalty for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因违反规则而受到惩罚。
